Folks,
We are almost at the pivot point.
We've been focused on voter registration all year -- it's been our number one priority, starting with reengaging lapsed voters and attracting new voters to our outreach on the ground and advertising online. Now that we've put in all that effort, our focus is starting to pivot to voter mobilization.
We’ll continue to use proven tactics to contact voters — directly and indirectly — to make sure this critical election stays top of mind. We’re blanketing our targeted states with text messages, emails, digital advertising, and more, all with one simple focus: I ncreasing voter turnout.
This is hugely important because voting is a habit that lasts a lifetime . New voters will become voters who make their voices heard on state and local issues that impact communities across the country. If more people vote, our policies and elected leaders will be more representative of the population. This is our unique opportunity to surge voters to the polls, and we need your help to do it.

body:
GOTV is going to be the whole ballgame soon, Team. We either help turn out the countless new voters that we've helped register as part of the pro-democracy coalition -- along with millions of voting rights supporters -- or we watch the wave of voter suppression continue to flow through state legislatures next year.
Your $25 (or more) could make all the difference, Team. Stand up to protect voting rights by supporting our GOTV program from now through early voting and all the way to Election Day >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-gotv?refcode=090824_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=090824_3&amount=25]
Folks,
We are almost at the pivot point.
We've been focused on voter registration all year -- it's been our number one priority, starting with reengaging lapsed voters and attracting new voters to our outreach on the ground and advertising online. Now that we've put in all that effort, our focus is starting to pivot to voter mobilization.
We’ll continue to use proven tactics to contact voters — directly and indirectly — to make sure this critical election stays top of mind. We’re blanketing our targeted states with text messages, emails, digital advertising, and more, all with one simple focus: I ncreasing voter turnout.
This is hugely important because voting is a habit that lasts a lifetime . New voters will become voters who make their voices heard on state and local issues that impact communities across the country. If more people vote, our policies and elected leaders will be more representative of the population. This is our unique opportunity to surge voters to the polls, and we need your help to do it.

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. Peter -- When President Biden called to say he was no longer going to run for reelection and was endorsing me instead, I was filled with gratitude -- humbled by his endorsement and with the outpouring of support from grassroots donors across the country. So today, I wanted to share some behind-the-scenes moments from that day and the people that helped make our success possible. It was a typical Sunday. My family was staying with us and we had just had pancakes, and we were about to do a puzzle when the phone rang. It was Joe Biden. And then everything changed. One of the first donations came seconds after the President endorsed me. It was from Victoria, a cosmetologist from Wilkesboro, North Carolina. She gave $25. Just seconds later, Sharon from Walnut Creek, California, donated $12 of her own. At just about the same time, Alberta who works security in Kingstree, South Carolina, added $10. And we were off... By the end of the day, we had received more than 500,000 individual donations, and the momentum has not stopped. Just yesterday, we announced a record number of donations in the month of August -- each one coming from a person who has their own motivations and story to tell about their help. Your support is humbling. While I have no doubt we can raise the kind of money it will take to win, we haven't done it yet. Far from it. clean_body: | | | Peter -- When President Biden called to say he was no longer going to run for reelection and was endorsing me instead, I was filled with gratitude -- humbled by his endorsement and with the outpouring of support from grassroots donors across the country. So today, I wanted to share some behind-the-scenes moments from that day and the people that helped make our success possible. It was a typical Sunday. My family was staying with us and we had just had pancakes, and we were about to do a puzzle when the phone rang. It was Joe Biden. And then everything changed. One of the first donations came seconds after the President endorsed me. It was from Victoria, a cosmetologist from Wilkesboro, North Carolina. She gave $25. Just seconds later, Sharon from Walnut Creek, California, donated $12 of her own. At just about the same time, Alberta who works security in Kingstree, South Carolina, added $10. And we were off... By the end of the day, we had received more than 500,000 individual donations, and the momentum has not stopped. Just yesterday, we announced a record number of donations in the month of August -- each one coming from a person who has their own motivations and story to tell about their help. Your support is humbling. While I have no doubt we can raise the kind of money it will take to win, we haven't done it yet. Far from it. The record number of donations we have received has put us in a strong position to win this race. It means the world to me. Today, I am asking you to join them with a donation of your own. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Thank you in advance for contributing -- especially today. Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States | | | |

subject: all of this . . . and more!
body:
Elections have life or death consequences...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

The stakes are higher than ever before, as radical abortion referendums are on the ballot in multiple states this November, including:

| |
---|---
\- Arizona | \- Florida
\- Missouri | \- Montana
\- Nebraska | \- Nevada
\- South Dakota

_Planned Parenthood_ wants nothing more than to end millions of little preborn lives across the country, and they’ve launched a full-blown propaganda campaign in these referendum states to try to accomplish their “goal.”

Of course, with the Abortion Lobby’s bloody millions at their disposal – _as well as pro-abortion media elites covering for them_ – just fighting their propaganda alone has proven difficult . . .

**Winning these ballot fights in November is going to take everything we’ve got.**

But I’ve got good news too, Pro-Life Friend.

**[With your full support, we have what it takes to take down the Abortion Goliath in November](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijckd-duchtdja-y/).**

You see, even as I send you this email, _Students for Life Action_ is hammering down with our **2024 Referendum Battleplan,** which includes our dedicated student activists conducting critical voter outreach programs using key election materials to turn out the pro-life vote!

Materials like:
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijckd-duchtdja-j/)

**-_Ballot Referendum Kits_ –** which we’re using to educate voters and help push back against ballot initiatives undertaken by the Abortion Lobby across the country!

**-_Yard Signs_ –** which we’re handing out to pro-lifers in Referendum States so they can be placed in thousands of yards to spread the pro-life message far and wide!

**-_Postcards_ –** which we’re mailing out and are designed to get voters to hear from you and our pro-life student leaders that preborn children are crying out for them this election.

And with these materials, our student activists are being deployed across the country to:

**• _CONDUCT GRASSROOTS TRAININGS_ –** where we train new young activists so they can start making an impact, effectively knock on doors, make phone calls, and stay in the fight for years to come;

**• _RAMP UP DOOR-TO-DOOR CANVASSING_ –** where our students will personally knock on hundreds of thousands of doors and even collaborate with homeschool groups and church communities to expand our reach;

**• _HOLD EARLY VOTER AND VOTER REGISTRATION EVENTS_ –** where we target ideal voter bases like mega-churches, church conferences, and Christian college campuses to beat the Left to the punch on early voting;

**• _EXPAND OUR ON-CAMPUS OUTREACH_ –** where we’ll host campus voter rallies and educational displays, recruit volunteers, organize door-to-door canvassing deployments, and even bus pro-life voters to the polls who don’t have a ride; and

**• _RUN NON-STOP PHONE BANKS AND TEXTING PROGRAMS_ –** where we’ll conduct peer-to-peer text messaging and phone calls which are a must in any effective Get-Out-The-Vote programs.
## **[>> DONATE TO _STUDENTS FOR LIFE ACTION’S_ 2024 REFERENDUM BATTLEPLAN << ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijckd-duchtdja-t/)**
Pro-Life Friend, these efforts could not be more critical.

In fact, they’re already having a huge impact!

Right now, in Florida, we’re leading the charge against the Abortion Lobby’s radical _Amendment 4_ late-term abortion referendum they’re trying to force on the Sunshine State.

Not only that, but our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** is due for a stop there from September 12th – 13th at _Florida International University_ & _Florida Atlantic University_ as well, where we’ll be screening the famous pro-life movie, _Unplanned._

This movie is one of the most powerful tools the Pro-Life Movement has right now in turning young people against abortion, as many pro-abortion/on-the-fence students who watch it have their eyes opened on the evils of abortion.

Once our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** is finished in Florida, it’ll head to other Referendum States like Arizona, Missouri, and Nebraska to convert young people there, too!
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijckd-duchtdja-i/)
As I said earlier, winning these ballot initiative fights in November is going to take everything we’ve got.

**Which is why we’re giving it exactly that!**

But I need to know I can count on good folks like you to do the same – _especially with everything on the line in 2024._

**[So, will you please consider chipping in and making your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ to help us continue running our 2024 Referendum Battleplan in key Referendum States](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijckd-duchtdja-d/)?**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – For preborn children, elections have _life_ or _death_ consequences.

This November, states across the country are facing extreme pro-abortion ballot measures that, if passed, could legalize abortion-on-demand up until birth.

**[_Students for Life Action_ is hammering down with our 2024 Referendum Battleplan, but I’ll need your help in order to make sure it’s a success](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijckd-duchtdja-h/).**

* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Their rise and fall
body:
We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqfmb8v8i7u7eaq8p0giira0sapm0bte43oee68g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5ctiecoj4cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkit705fa17g2auorv53pk2k1dron359svih3n50_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5ctiecoj4cph2bs) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmj93mc92f5gibo0lqjmnepo7h3erhosr0bjrn6o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5ctiecoj4cph2bs)
---
| | And, for a limited time, we’ll also send you a free color map of the Roman world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,”** along with the companion map today: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z38nno5qh70h48u2fnuonae686op0he6mliqej0o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5ctiecoj4cph2bs)** Learning the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way. That’s why we produced **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD. Before I go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Their rise and fall
body:
We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qAdNRCCINIqKgNq9pJrbFQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRov_~~)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qAdNRCCINIqKgNq9pJrbFQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRov_~~) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **
---
| [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qAdNRCCINIqKgNq9pJrbFQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRov_~~)
---
| | And, for a limited time, we’ll also send you a free color map of the Roman world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,”** along with the companion map today: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qAdNRCCINIqKgNq9pJrbFQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRov_~~)** Learning the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way. That’s why we produced **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD. Before I go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

body:
We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6n7q2euhaigrs53dd9r6fif3mt8q9006melh2lo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5ctie6o76cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf4f2qctmgi2avhu7n8eaue4cd2m9po4i8lur6c8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5ctie6o76cjh2bs) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **

---

This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,”** along with the companion map today: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z21d0n8b2c41va5n9piq2d1vle49mln0ifimb398_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5ctie6o76cjh2bs)** Learning the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way. That’s why we produced **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** and why I hope you’ll watch and share the course on DVD. Fellow American, _[_Claim your FREE copy of my NEW book_](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-aASxJv7wg8kZz_Q)_ , _Right Wing Revolution: How to Beat the Woke and Save the West,_ if you want the roadmap for how we return to an America where...
* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal to counter the toxic evils of "Woke" ideology.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---

| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---

| | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.

Our movement will be critical to whether legislative chambers flip party control in key states like...
* **Arizona** , where if we flip just two seats each in the State House and Senate, Democrats will take control and strengthen the state’s redistricting process.
* **Michigan** , where Republicans are trying to take back the State House and end the Democratic trifecta we helped win in 2022. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission.
* **Minnesota** , where Democrats won a trifecta in 2022, enacting Gov. Tim Walz’s bold agenda. Republicans only need to flip five seats to gain control of the State House and block all the amazing progress we’ve seen there this year.
* **New Hampshire** , where Democrats need to win majorities in the State House and Senate to prevent Republicans from engaging in mid-cycle partisan gerrymandering.
* **Pennsylvania** , where if we can protect the House Democratic majority and flip the Republican-controlled State Senate, we will achieve another Democratic trifecta.

**All of this is within our reach — _if_ we fight for it. And for that, we need _you_. name: Chuck Norris
subject: Don't be frightened
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia
body:
| | | This is Chuck Norris.

It's okay - don't be frightened.

I'm e-mailing you about my friend Hung Cao. I've known Hung for a long time.

## Man Arrested for Planned Attack on NY Jews
Canadian authorities have arrested a 20-year-old Pakistani national for a planned [mass shooting of Jews in Brooklyn](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7tuhDAQAL_G7g55176zKVykobu0KZEfy7GRwQgsUP4-utTpRhpppPl6js_AhdfXZ1jIt6mOITU-aexv7oZmNDL7iQhJS_Jg8e5A9Q-Qs7dAJibMAVIPKZKyYFH31qHWgR53yR4VGtUrB4gOsHMuBogZMk6akgrCKMrc6t59V17bTFP5qSftXaqLLH5ubTuE_hA4CByu6-piTG8ncFjpOgQOYW-cCr0x5WxPs21F7VXuPm8Xl8LHwwqjXkvg8ldt_y6eHn8DAAD__wvMUxw). Shahzeb Jadoon was detained Wednesday in Quebec. He planned the shooting on behalf of the Islamic State for October 7 to mark the first anniversary of the Hamas attacks in Israel. Canadian law enforcement stopped Jadoon [12 miles from the U.S. border](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOtCAUhZ8GOwxcHYWC4m_o5m-3NCiX8c4yMhFW4ttvnHqbk1N8yTn5vu7T3VGk7fHfvdCUkCa3FDpw0lxx6Ke-8SYgAnYNGjnCTUmhB9msBmFeENUwBqE7JwfVgfZqmOEWhAvaNWRAQC-0UBJASWiVmp2cvfQQOlyEY71ATyXt7TPRVlYM8UwH7u2SXk00aynvzLp_DCwDW2ttf7IrybvzAhjYXNJ-MrAb1szAvlOkQstVr2EGVugrRgY2zMQ3rPxM-zenTJk_sVJe-YJbwZ2BHW9S6k6P4sM3u_HvSjFSHkbWi8fLUfz8Kn9KOgz8BgAA__8r4Wcl). Two undercover officers had been communicating with the suspect since late 2023 [after he distributed ISIS propaganda](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFvgzAQBeBfA5vR-SDBDB66sKVrR3TYR3BibGS7oPz7KlXHbp_09KSn93WbbuS8C_dP2liXJU5kijt4GoQS2E1dbfXCjNzWrGWPFyVhuMp61bMdLFBr5cUCSAuym0l1dpiN6g30c-00AnYwgJKISmKj1ExyttLi0rIBqjpg60pMzSO6UFZe_CsenBoTt9rrtZQ9V-1HhWOF43meTZhN4DO_8wrHNyscv7P400ZBUEqcC1tB3vOdrdg9BfF03osHny6vYue4e353xCump4imiF5QCO7glCmJZALJHkBinbTdT-e9y9e-6uC-kfO_68q_Vx0afwIAAP__bfht8g), and they were tipped off to the planned attack.
## Starliner Returns to Earth Unmanned
Boeing's Starliner [successfully returned unmanned to Earth](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0Lty6yAURuGnkTo0sCXrUlCcRp1Pm1LD5cciweABbJK3zyR16tWs-d6ux1X54OPtv7pDVpcOZap_4djYymg6pt5KBxDGHlIsdFkF32bRn9IKQFs1c8y4AGKhiRZtR7eRFRCX3kviNPGNr4JoFTSsq1ZCW2HJjTBcdROH9TXl4T35WE-48JVeyINJ9z7Is9ZH6cZ_He0d7a21waXPiFZ-ekd7MR7RoKNdJ_h4K6zm9NQBlpWqcvARmZWHMjBZucqCirYwrcwHg8r1ZM3XMz0rMxmtz9I-mg_Bl3npJn67Kx9-R-qfKi9J3wEAAP__aOhonQ) Friday. The spacecraft delivered astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams to the International Space Station in June, but due to issues on Boeing's first crewed test flight, NASA determined it should [return to Earth without its crew](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb_G7rBgwDYuKF6TLq_d0hrDOJkVgQiIrf37VVJvda90iiOdr-t6RY6cbv_xQa7teUXf-KB1EVaAWU0f3E4EpHtyaobRKrlMqr87O-pRT17tYMZNGT9KT_sSEMMsN2Pnnh1IMHKRVgFYBYO1G6otqAC7Ji-xM5ICt1yG78yp3WmPP_mgMvj86KO7t_asnf7XwaWDy3meQ9p8orO-eQeX6pmSp_d74me3TJxuojYskRMVUai9ShIpC6yt5ISvVkXxCdW0aD31xYXnyTFynebOyNsDOX7s7c8Uh4PfAAAA___n3GJd). NASA commissioned a SpaceX craft to bring the astronauts home in February. Their mission was initially planned to last about eight days. A livestream of the landing in New Mexico seemed to indicate [Starliner returned without a hitch](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL-OrCAUh58GOwwcHZWC4jZ2c9stDcJB2WVgAscx8_Ybp9729yf58n3dl7sJMaTtv3mgJp8XYym8cFF84tAvfeO0RwTsGtRyhNskhRpks2tUq7e3QUo_KmeGwQnpVj-uChz2t6lrggYBvVBikgCThHaaViNXJx34Dq0wrBfoAuXSfueQaEcf3_mFpbX50US9Ez0r6_4xmBnM53m2BQ_CUq-ewUxo95Rj3t4M5vo0Fq9ZoD0fxE2lkpM5qPI1Y0hb5ZVMiSFh4Udy2f5U_jldOYWc-EXLheJiYDA3RbvnGWIMdRhZL7aHCfEDRn9aemn4DQAA__-5dGxg).
## List: Countries That Drink the Most Beer
Europeans dominate the world in beer consumption per capita, [according to a study of 2022 data.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuO6yAUheGnwR0WbONbQXEadzntlBaXTbJnMFiY2Mrbj5J6yiV90pL-r9t6MxQp3f-bDXUNeTWu0onrzCcOalWN1wERsGtQyxH6SYp5kM1D2wFsNwYnAcWoPPTQz8ENs_cDGuxVQxoEKDGLSQJMEtppskZaLz2EDp0wTAn0VHNpvzOl-sAQX_nE0rq8NVE_at0P1v1jsDBYrutqTzqeJjqzUzWRjvqGDJZi0g96bhELdzkdz22vlBPf3_uDuX1xl5-plheDpSna7xfFSMcwMiXum6H4Oa1_Fjg1_AYAAP__Ft5gkg) Czechia tops the list for the 30th consecutive year, consuming 188.5 liters of beer per capita--almost 90 liters more than Austria, at number two. The average Czech drinks more than one bottle of beer daily. The top nine countries are all in Europe, with the African nation of Namibia claiming the tenth spot. The U.S. comes in at 31, and incidentally, Americans [rank European beers as their favorites](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1u7CAQQOGnsTssmPUPFBS3cbe3TWkNMN6dBBsLWFv79lFSpz_Skb6P-3JHjrw__uNGtq5pQV_5pMUILaBf-jbYlQjo1pJVEwxaSTOq9mlBuyno0ZEz3ptRGumHydA4-MGP3k0tW5DQSyO1AtAKOq0dKhdUgPVGXmLTSwpcU-4-E-_1SWt8p5Ny59PWRvus9SjN7V8DcwPzdV3dyeWF0ePBFSOX-hM2MGfcvygI3CizxyK2VKo40vGKmIUjykW4t3jQThkrp72Buc02HBfHyGWcml4-NuT4-61_IpwWvgMAAP__VZxhww).

East Africa has just endured its worst drought in 40 years, leaving tens of millions without access to clean water, wiping out millions of livestock, and destroying crops. With domestic food production crippled, Somalia has relied heavily on imports--90% of its wheat coming from Russia and Ukraine--until those shipments stopped. Now, two in five children in Somalia suffer from acute malnutrition, and cholera is spreading in some regions. The food crisis, compounded by global humanitarian aid being redirected to Europe and the Middle East, has created a perfect storm, leading to a sharp rise in child malnutrition. name: The Editors at Broad + Liberty
subject: Big Shift in St. Joe's Professor Bias Case
body:
News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | |
---
| | | Good morning and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Weekly Reads.

[Subscribe to our daily email list](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0878824968&e=b7b3eddce2) and get the best of _Broad + Liberty_ delivered straight to your inbox.

|
---
|
### **1.[Court filing: University investigation shows that SJU fired professor with no evidence of wrongdoing](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a6e0a4b89e&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Todd Shepherd_
A new court filing in a lawsuit by a former St. Joseph’s University professor against his old employer sheds new light on the investigation the university conducted into claims against the professor’s character — and a number of quotes from that investigation’s final report suggest the university had little, if anything, to hold against him. In 2021, the university investigated visiting mathematics professor Greg Manco after multiple allegations — mostly on social media at the time — that Manco had acted with racial bias in his classroom. But[ the new court filing](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=491f73f637&e=b7b3eddce2) quotes the university’s investigation as saying “there is no evidence that Manco treated students unfairly based on race or any other protected characteristic while they were a student in his class.” After the investigation had concluded, Manco’s status as visiting professor[ was later revoked](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d49859b36e&e=b7b3eddce2) when the university decided to rescind his contract and make him an adjunct professor instead — a move that resulted in lower pay and far fewer benefits. The university said the action was needed because of budget constraints, but Manco, who had worked at St. Joe’s for 17 years, said it was retaliation.
**Why It Matters. **According to the court filing, the SJU investigation into Manco’s conduct found “Colbert did not provide any direct evidence of discrimination or harassment while she was a student in Manco’s class, and there is no evidence that Manco treated Colbert differently because of her race.” "These Twitter posts appear to represent Manco’s own personal opinions, and do not suggest in any way that they represent the views of the University,” the investigation also found. "I further conclude that the Twitter comments at issue on Manco’s Twitter account do not constitute harassment and did not create an intimidating or hostile learning environment under University policy,” the investigator wrote elsewhere in the report.
**Quotable.** Manco’s attorney, Joe Toddy, said as the discovery phase has progressed, all the evidence he is seeing points just one direction. "I’ve not seen one document that St. Joe’s or any of the alumni defendants have provided us that does not make me have even more belief in Greg’s case. As we pointed out in our original pleading, Greg was made a scapegoat. It’s very obvious,” Toddy said. "I’ve reviewed their investigation documents and they exonerated Greg. Of course, St. Joe’s chose to tell the media something completely else, kept him on administrative leave, cut down his classes, and then when he had the temerity to file this lawsuit, they then tried to hide behind FERPA and fire him. And it’s just not right.”
**[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=951b8b981c&e=b7b3eddce2)**
---
|
---
|
### **2.[The Reagan movie that the mainstream media doesn’t want you to see](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=54b91b9520&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Beth Ann Rosica_
There is a reason the legacy media, including Facebook, doesn’t want you to see it — there are significant parallels between Reagan’s time and our country’s current trajectory.

But first, “Reagan” is simply a great movie. Told from the perspective of a retired Russian spy, played expertly by veteran actor, Jon Voight, the movie chronicles Reagan’s life from a young boy to the White House. Dennis Quaid delivers a convincing performance as the 40th President through his mannerisms, affect, and speech; and Penelope Ann Miller is as strong and endearing as his wife, Nancy.

It is a feel-good movie that makes you proud to be an American. The film not only commemorates Reagan and his accomplishments, it celebrates what is best about our country.

**Why It Matters**. In the midst of this highly contentious presidential election, it was refreshing to spend over two hours remembering what our country is supposed to stand for, represented by a man who was respectful but firm, polished but funny, unwavering in his commitment to freedom and peace, a grateful husband, and a man of faith.

The fact that the movie was released by a new company dedicated to overcoming the “traditional studios’ [i.e. progressive] selection distribution processes” may be reason number one why the mainstream media doesn’t want you to see it.

Hollywood and the legacy media are tied together in a mission to support liberal political agendas; and therefore, they will do what they can to prevent any messaging to the contrary.

[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1af5100691&e=b7b3eddce2)

# **4\. What we're reading**
This week, our friends at _The Free Press_ published an article that thoroughly explains a point that, until recently, everyone in this country understood: in World War II, [we were the good guys](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=50e2325ed1&e=b7b3eddce2). History professor and _National Review_ writer Victor Davis Hanson summarizes the themes and events of mankind’s deadliest war and reminds us that, despite what you may have heard on Tucker Carlson’s show, the Axis powers started the war and the Allies were right to defeat them. Seems obvious! And yet, in these times even obvious things need repeating.

clean_body: News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | | | | | Good morning and welcome to Broad + Liberty 's Weekly Reads. and get the best of Broad + Liberty delivered straight to your inbox. | | 1. By Todd Shepherd A new court filing in a lawsuit by a former St. Joseph’s University professor against his old employer sheds new light on the investigation the university conducted into claims against the professor’s character — and a number of quotes from that investigation’s final report suggest the university had little, if anything, to hold against him. In 2021, the university investigated visiting mathematics professor Greg Manco after multiple allegations — mostly on social media at the time — that Manco had acted with racial bias in his classroom. But quotes the university’s investigation as saying “there is no evidence that Manco treated students unfairly based on race or any other protected characteristic while they were a student in his class.” After the investigation had concluded, Manco’s status as visiting professor when the university decided to rescind his contract and make him an adjunct professor instead — a move that resulted in lower pay and far fewer benefits. The university said the action was needed because of budget constraints, but Manco, who had worked at St. Joe’s for 17 years, said it was retaliation. Why It Matters. According to the court filing, the SJU investigation into Manco’s conduct found “Colbert did not provide any direct evidence of discrimination or harassment while she was a student in Manco’s class, and there is no evidence that Manco treated Colbert differently because of her race.” "These Twitter posts appear to represent Manco’s own personal opinions, and do not suggest in any way that they represent the views of the University,” the investigation also found. "I further conclude that the Twitter comments at issue on Manco’s Twitter account do not constitute harassment and did not create an intimidating or hostile learning environment under University policy,” the investigator wrote elsewhere in the report. Quotable. Manco’s attorney, Joe Toddy, said as the discovery phase has progressed, all the evidence he is seeing points just one direction. "I’ve not seen one document that St. Joe’s or any of the alumni defendants have provided us that does not make me have even more belief in Greg’s case. As we pointed out in our original pleading, Greg was made a scapegoat. It’s very obvious,” Toddy said. "I’ve reviewed their investigation documents and they exonerated Greg. Of course, St. Joe’s chose to tell the media something completely else, kept him on administrative leave, cut down his classes, and then when he had the temerity to file this lawsuit, they then tried to hide behind FERPA and fire him. And it’s just not right.” | | 2. By Beth Ann Rosica There is a reason the legacy media, including Facebook, doesn’t want you to see it — there are significant parallels between Reagan’s time and our country’s current trajectory. But first, “Reagan” is simply a great movie. Told from the perspective of a retired Russian spy, played expertly by veteran actor, Jon Voight, the movie chronicles Reagan’s life from a young boy to the White House. Dennis Quaid delivers a convincing performance as the 40th President through his mannerisms, affect, and speech; and Penelope Ann Miller is as strong and endearing as his wife, Nancy. It is a feel-good movie that makes you proud to be an American. The film not only commemorates Reagan and his accomplishments, it celebrates what is best about our country. Why It Matters. In the midst of this highly contentious presidential election, it was refreshing to spend over two hours remembering what our country is supposed to stand for, represented by a man who was respectful but firm, polished but funny, unwavering in his commitment to freedom and peace, a grateful husband, and a man of faith. The fact that the movie was released by a new company dedicated to overcoming the “traditional studios’ [i.e. progressive] selection distribution processes” may be reason number one why the mainstream media doesn’t want you to see it. Hollywood and the legacy media are tied together in a mission to support liberal political agendas; and therefore, they will do what they can to prevent any messaging to the contrary. | | 3\. name: Christopher Plamp | COO | USO
subject: Sept. 11 changed everything.
body:
Please show your support for our heroes.
[](https://www.uso.org)
[SIGN THE CARD](https://links.e.uso.)
---
|
---
★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ | |
---
USO Supporter,
Though it has been 23 years since that fateful day, the impact of 9/11 continues to resonate deeply with millions of American families, including my own.
That Tuesday morning started like any other for me. I'd spent my first decade in the Air Force flying missions all over the world. By the time of the attacks, **I 'd been with special operations for about a year. I got the news soon after arriving at work that morning, and everything changed. **
I can't share much about those early days, but in a very short time, I found myself deployed in the Middle East. The following seven years saw me repeatedly in Afghanistan and Iraq, fighting the war that began on that day.
But for all I endured, it was even harder on my wife. After the towers fell and I was quickly deployed, she was left to care for our 2-year-old child -- alone. There were times when we didn't speak to each other for months.
Our entire nation was reeling from an unimaginable tragedy. With the weight of all that, there was my wife watching the news every day -- knowing I was thousands of miles away fighting but without the faintest idea where exactly I was or what was happening to me. **Even now, the thought of it breaks my heart.**
I made it home that Christmas, and it felt like a total miracle. But I was gone again in no time. And so it went for almost seven years. **That 's why we say it's not just the service member who serves -- it's the entire family. Each and every one of them has their own story of service and sacrifice.**
At the USO, our mission is to support every single one of our service members and their families -- no matter what. And as we approach the 23rd anniversary of 9/11, we've set a goal of collecting at least 50,000 signatures via email and SMS from military supporters like you on our card of gratitude for those who put everything on the line for our country.
**[Can I count on you to add your name?](https://links.e.uso.)** It means the world to our service members to see your support, and it reassures their families that this community stands with them, no matter what. **[So please, take just a moment to add your name here.](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/KAeVs7dNP_QZ/Y25BRGxqT1hhWWMxMnpOc0UzSHB0UW9JWkU1S1M0eEx1c0Z4SnhIZG81Y20vaWFKMjE4bzVzd1BURWx0M2FDcEprMzBaSjQzMFpacnFSYWxHN1QwUmhTTEdHZG0yNGxMcm5VRmdwRUdGRUE9S0/WkJoRWp0Q09keWRWQnBTVXNNSXI2L1VlSTA3VU95Si8xb0t2S2R3ZzhmY0xXQ0FzUXZyZUhlbGlVZDJnQUZiTnIwcVA3dVM1RTVObEF3ZlJQNWp6a0JtRmIwTnBJWkhNS0)**
Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for all that you do to support our heroes.
Christopher Plamp, COO, USO

Our momentum is stronger than ever, and with the final stretch ahead, every day counts. Your financial support will help us fund: 📱 Organizing — Phone banking, regional outreach, and knocking on doors to talk directly to voters. 🪧 Visibility — Printing signs, flyers, and informational materials to get Gloria’s message out across the state. 📺 Media — Running TV, radio, and online ads to reach voters wherever they are. 🚗 Travel — Hitting the road to meet with communities in all 95 counties of Tennessee. This is a campaign by and for the people. Without your grassroots support, none of this would be possible. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you so much! Team Gloria Any donor history information in this email reflects what we have on file for this specific email address and sometimes takes up to a week to sync in our systems. If you have donated — thank you so much! We have that on file and cannot thank you enough for supporting this campaign. | = Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care. # **Fighting for Progress in America's Heartland**
---
|
---
| | | | Rural communities across the United States are facing unprecedented challenges, and it's time for us to come together to address them head-on. No Dem Left Behind is leading the charge. We believe that by focusing on critical issues affecting rural America, we can make a real impact in 2024. _Here are the four key issues we're tackling:_ **Rural Hospitals:** Since 2005, 104 rural hospitals in the United States have closed, and an additional 600 are at risk. Democrats understand the importance of accessible healthcare, and we are committed to reversing this trend. Your support will help us elect leaders who prioritize healthcare for all, ensuring that rural communities have the resources they need. **CAFOs & Zoning:** Concentrated Animal Feeding Operations (CAFOs) are threatening community health and the livelihood of family farms. Our Democratic candidates are dedicated to implementing responsible policies that protect both our communities and the environment. By supporting us, you contribute to a future where sustainable farming practices thrive. **Rural Broadband:** **The lack of reliable broadband in rural areas hinders economic growth and limits access to education and healthcare. We support the FCC's efforts to reinstate net neutrality rules, ensuring that** every American, regardless of their zip code, has equal access to the opportunities provided by the internet. Help us bridge the digital divide and connect rural America. **Renewable Incentives:** **Our commitment to a sustainable future is reflected in** the Inflation Reduction Act and American Rescue Plan. By electing Democrats, we ensure that these programs are not only protected but expanded. Let's empower Americans to lead more sustainable lives and provide financial compensation for embracing renewable practices. **We are proud to share that our initiatives extend to key swing states like Pennsylvania, Georgia, and Florida**. By focusing on these states, we aim to create a ripple effect that strengthens our party's presence nationwide. [**_Now, more than ever, we need your support. Your contribution will help us elect Democrats who will champion these causes and build a brighter future for rural America._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2upj8x-eugd98-kyd76rh0/)

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: I could be the first. But I need your help to do it, Peter.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help.
#

Peter, Arizona is about 33% Latino. If I win my race, it’ll be the first time any of those people will see someone who looks like them representing our state in the U.S. Senate.
I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help. [**If you’ve got my back and are ready to make that happen, could you make a donation of $5 or anything you can afford to help us win this race?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept24.kTsNbj&refcode=em240908-1-160&t=1&akid=3028%2E734936%2Et0Bej4)
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept24.kTsNbj&refcode=em240908-1-160&t=2&akid=3028%2E734936%2Et0Bej4)
Kids who grow up the way I did don’t make their way to the U.S. Senate. Statistically speaking, I never should’ve made it to college.
But thanks to my mom, my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard.
I served in the Marines, and I fought in Iraq.
I came back, and I got elected to Congress. I served almost 10 years, fighting for my people. And now, I’m taking on Kari Lake and the MAGA-right to defend Arizona and take back a critical seat in the U.S. Senate.
Talking heads have been telling us for months that this race would come down to the wire, and right now the polls are narrowing considerably. It’s a fight to the finish. What I need more than anything else is the resources to fight back against the waves of attacks and ads coming my way.
To win, I need you to join me in this fight. With you, we can do it. Without you, I don’t have a shot.
[**Please, can you afford to chip in $5 and help me become the first Latino Senator from Arizona? A Senator for ALL Arizonans, no matter what party they belong to or what country their family came from.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept24.kTsNbj&refcode=em240908-1-160&t=3&akid=3028%2E734936%2Et0Bej4)

I developed a keen nose for bullsh*t as an Army officer.
In the military when you are in uniform you always have to wear your hat (we call it a ‘cover’) when you are _outside_. Well, I had a couple of soldiers who never seemed to be at their stations inside our hangar, but their covers were always there – implying they were somewhere _inside._
It didn’t take long for me to check those covers out of curiosity, and wouldn’t you know they were brand-spanking-new. Those soldiers were trying to pull one over on me while they walked around outside with their extra covers on!
So the next time they left those decoy covers at their desk, I soaked them in water and put them in the freezer for them to find. Safe to say, they stayed at their stations after that.
**Just like I could tell those soldiers were trying to see how much BS they could get away with – I can tell Brian Fitzpatrick is pulling the same bullsh*t with his fake claims of being a "moderate."**
A moderate doesn't block abortion freedom, our right to vote, or gun safety. A moderate doesn't enable extremists like Matt Gaetz and Marjorie Taylor Greene.
**But freezing a few hats isn't going to get the job done this time. Nope, to teach Fitzpatrick a lesson, we have to get really tough – and kick him out of office.**

body:
Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms.
| Friend, I’m Riley Gaines. You may have heard my name in the news. I’m an All-American swimmer -- but I’m better known for my role in the fight to save women’s sports.
Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. **Just this year, a female golfer lost her spot in the U.S. Women’s Open qualifier at Bradenton to a man, James “Hailey” Davidson.** Then, USA Today _took down_ a brilliant op-ed by Republican Senator John Kennedy. In the op-ed, he demanded to know if “inclusion” should be prioritized over fairness and safety when it comes to sports. But Friend, I won’t be censored! Instead, I seek to build a community of thousands of sensible Americans who know the difference between a man and a woman. I started the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute so that women would have a place to speak out against the gender ideology radicals. Please, join me and stand for women, free speech, and common sense.

With November less than 2 months away, I realized it’s more important than ever to share why exactly I decided to run for Congress in the first place.

Leslie Mehta is a civil rights attorney, a mom, and a proud Democrat running to flip Virginia’s 1st Congressional District. If you would like to unsubscribe, [click here](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/qilL9Kv-dUyGV2oDr4ABqg2?unsubscribedata=zkBOGy1VkYs3ZMtq%2Bae9YyKeu6H9zjKYu0CZZKeick0OZuWUZhK5jVZGIjZFFeQI%2Fr5%2BwYZdy60PhwR4fUkZ%2BSePp0lhXtiUB9XvcjuCfpYOcX8nnhFZRYsiU9PHlsIJE6AYVeexnywr%2FhKKV2y6YyHUCGlSV2OgweOyttDTUUW6bPULJWbCsrHlFN12WboBLWdzTh0bpwnaxw83bJBgidOfaOjzuw3R%2Fs4%2F2p1HLKWTKp%2F%2Fkc68b1uE2iggE06hbmH8Xfn2hwxHF4kkayxh47eW6Bzwa6jSC34vJAWrSRorLzYOXGzXtocOma%2BJPJ2ooAt5cR6okWPrr%2FejpTZYqGoRtl70PICrCmMVvv5GLeZ97fXVFMiKIptZptXfiKIlhObJNsYXsk6zT%2BrkmlJS6sntsa5VGlvekPkdo3F6Ph3wyAC1MLGj2fKiVk6dcXs9)

Peter, with November less than 2 months away, I realized it’s more important than ever to share why exactly I decided to run for Congress in the first place. If you know me — and I’m proud that countless folks across Virginia’s 1st already do — and are already #TeamLeslie all the way, [consider chipping in to our campaign fund here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92406899/497008953/773580338?source=SBD_LM_EM_FR_090824_1_1_Story&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzMTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZThjYmMzNDItZWU2ZC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uizHGECyttDNU-obILuaEmMJcmPMtyL1GuRsSPRBJSw=) If you’re still on the fence, I encourage you to read on. Peter, I was born and raised in a small town in North Carolina, with 800 residents and zero traffic lights. My parents, a corrections officer and a social worker, instilled in me early on the importance of service and giving back where you can — something that I’ve held onto ever since. It’s a value I held throughout my undergraduate and law school career, and that I lived every day when I became the Legal Director of the ACLU of Virginia, where I fought tooth and nail to advocate for the civil rights and liberties of _all_ Virginians, regardless of political belief. I did the same when I was appointed by both Ralph Northam and Glenn Youngkin to work under their administrations. And it’s the same reason I’m running for Congress — to give the people of VA-01 — _all the people_ — the leadership they’ve been lacking with Rob Wittman for far too long. We don’t need someone who votes with Donald Trump over 90% of the time — we need someone who votes for our families, our small businesses, and the communities we are proud to call our own. I’m a mother, a wife, and a proud advocate for the change we need here at home and across the country. I know the issues because I’ve lived them — unlike my opponent who’s had “politician” on his resume for nearly 4 decades. [This is our moment to make a change here in Virginia’s 1st, and I hope that I can count on you to help me do it. Will you send a donation of any amount, be it $50 or just $10, to my campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92406900/497008954/773580338?amount=50&source=SBD_LM_EM_FR_090824_1_1_Story&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzMTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZThjYmMzNDItZWU2ZC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uizHGECyttDNU-obILuaEmMJcmPMtyL1GuRsSPRBJSw=) | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now.

Peter, I was born and raised in a small town in North Carolina, with 800 residents and zero traffic lights. My parents, a corrections officer and a social worker, instilled in me early on the importance of service and giving back where you can — something that I’ve held onto ever since. It’s a value I held throughout my undergraduate and law school career, and that I lived every day when I became the Legal Director of the ACLU of Virginia, where I fought tooth and nail to advocate for the civil rights and liberties of all Virginians, regardless of political belief. I did the same when I was appointed by both Ralph Northam and Glenn Youngkin to work under their administrations. And it’s the same reason I’m running for Congress — to give the people of VA-01 — all the people — the leadership they’ve been lacking with Rob Wittman for far too long. We don’t need someone who votes with Donald Trump over 90% of the time — we need someone who votes for our families, our small businesses, and the communities we are proud to call our own. I’m a mother, a wife, and a proud advocate for the change we need here at home and across the country. Hey, Peter. It's Jen, Chair of the Harris-Walz campaign. I've seen a lot of chatter online today about our fundraising and I have to set the record straight. I hope you’ll take a second to read about our progress over the past few weeks, what’s coming next, and why we’re counting on you to stay in this fight through the finish line. –Jen
* * *
**Here’s Where We’re At** In August, we pulled in a record-breaking $361 million -- nearly tripling the Trump campaign’s August haul. August was also the best grassroots fundraising month in presidential history all thanks to this team. What this team has accomplished over the past 7 weeks is incredible. And it’s all thanks to the joy and enthusiasm that the Vice President and Governor are bringing to the table. But I’m here to remind you: _We cannot let up._ **As Vice President Harris has said since day one, we are the underdogs in this race.** We have a lot of work to do to make sure we win this November, and that will require us to continue aggressively raising money. The Electoral College benefits the Republican ticket. Even in 2020, when the Biden-Harris ticket won more votes than any ticket in history, the election came down to about 45,000 votes across the battleground states. This November, we anticipate margins to be similarly razor-thin. _Every single vote will count._ **A Quick Reality Check** Here's the deal: Donald Trump's megadonors are padding the coffers of far-right super PACs at a breakneck speed. And they’re not just sitting on that money. They are pouring it into ads in critical swing states to attack Vice President Harris. Trump’s rich buddies have put half a billion dollars behind him -- more than our entire, record-breaking August raise. _And that’s just his friends._ Over the past month, pro-Trump super PAC spending attacking the Vice President totaled $195 million -- besting our $150 million spend on paid media during that same time. _And it’s only what they’ve announced so far._ **While Trump is all in on one to two “must win” states, our campaign strategy relies on a wide map.** Our best pathway to 270 electoral votes requires us to aggressively compete in every battleground state. And playing in every battleground requires significant resources. **Where You Come In** I can't thank you enough for being a part of this team. But we have to keep it up. _**Donald Trump and his allies are already outspending us by millions of dollars, have much, much more cash waiting in the wings, and have a much smaller ball game to fund.**_ _The only way we can keep pace with their level of investment is if grassroots supporters like you stay in the fight._ [**Will you please pitch in a $25 donation today? You are the backbone of this campaign. I hope you’ll take a second to read about our progress over the past few weeks, what’s coming next, and why we’re counting on you to stay in this fight through the finish line. –Jen Here’s Where We’re At In August, we pulled in a record-breaking $361 million -- nearly tripling the Trump campaign’s August haul. August was also the best grassroots fundraising month in presidential history all thanks to this team. What this team has accomplished over the past 7 weeks is incredible. And it’s all thanks to the joy and enthusiasm that the Vice President and Governor are bringing to the table. But I’m here to remind you: We cannot let up. As Vice President Harris has said since day one, we are the underdogs in this race. We have a lot of work to do to make sure we win this November, and that will require us to continue aggressively raising money. The Electoral College benefits the Republican ticket. Even in 2020, when the Biden-Harris ticket won more votes than any ticket in history, the election came down to about 45,000 votes across the battleground states. This November, we anticipate margins to be similarly razor-thin. Every single vote will count. A Quick Reality Check Here's the deal: Donald Trump's megadonors are padding the coffers of far-right super PACs at a breakneck speed. And they’re not just sitting on that money. They are pouring it into ads in critical swing states to attack Vice President Harris. Trump’s rich buddies have put half a billion dollars behind him -- more than our entire, record-breaking August raise. And that’s just his friends. Over the past month, pro-Trump super PAC spending attacking the Vice President totaled $195 million -- besting our $150 million spend on paid media during that same time. And it’s only what they’ve announced so far. While Trump is all in on one to two “must win” states, our campaign strategy relies on a wide map. Our best pathway to 270 electoral votes requires us to aggressively compete in every battleground state. And playing in every battleground requires significant resources. Where You Come In I can't thank you enough for being a part of this team. But we have to keep it up. Donald Trump and his allies are already outspending us by millions of dollars, have much, much more cash waiting in the wings, and have a much smaller ball game to fund. The only way we can keep pace with their level of investment is if grassroots supporters like you stay in the fight. | | Rest assured, this weekend, our campaign will continue our important work. We have our largest Weekend of Action of the campaign planned with thousands of events across battlegrounds and tens of thousands of supporters doing the work to reach undecided voters. While we’re organizing on the ground, we’re also getting our message out over the airwaves. We’re investing $370 million to share the Vice President’s vision directly with voters and emphasize the real threat Trump’s Project 2025 poses to our country. These last 58 days are going to be hard. They're going to be a slog. The other side is going to try dragging us through the mud. But we can do hard things. We've done it before. We can do it again now. –Jen Jen O'Malley Dillon Chair, Harris for President | | | |

Team —
Donald and J.D. Vance aren’t just the most anti-woman, anti-democratic GOP ticket in history — they’re plain weird.
While most Americans are worried about putting dinner on the table, Donald and Vance are busy complaining that “childless cat ladies” are the real problem facing America. And they’re not just going after people who don’t have kids — they’re trying to control our personal decisions about pregnancy and parenthood entirely.
In Donald and Vance’s America, families like mine would be under attack. I’m a “cat lady” who is lucky enough to have a human child thanks to fertility treatments. But because of my uncle’s work to pack our courts with extremist judges that led to the overturning of Roe v. Wade and abortion bans across the country, right-wing activists and lawmakers are now looking to restrict access to IVF and other fertility treatments next.
These are scary times, but it’s good to know where everyone stands.
I stand with the women of America to protect our reproductive rights and bodily autonomy. So do Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. Walz has spoken openly about how he and his wife conceived their two children through fertility treatments. This fight is also personal to him.
We know where Donald and Vance stand. And we need to make sure neither of them gets anywhere near the Oval Office. Pitch in a split donation between Democracy Defense Fund and Seth Moulton so that we can elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, flip the House, and defend the Senate! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-ddf]
Last year, after Ohio voters overwhelmingly approved a constitutional amendment to protect reproductive rights, Vance called the people’s decision a “gut punch.”
We have the numbers. We can turn out millions of voters across the country who are ready to fight for our right to make our own decisions about our bodies and our families. So, this Election Day, let’s give Vance and Donald a gut punch they’ll remember.
In solidarity,
Dr. Mary L. Trump (and my cats Linden and Cap)

In 58 days, Virginia will decide who they want as their next U.S. Senator and their next President.
Ultimately, this election is about two different visions for our nation. One focused on the future . And one focused on the past .
Tim Kaine and I believe in a future where every person has the opportunity not just to get by, but to get ahead.
Where no child has to grow up in poverty. Where every worker has the freedom to join a union. Where every person has affordable health care, child care, and paid leave. Where every senior can retire with dignity.
But Donald Trump and his extremist Republican allies want to take our country backward. They intend to cut Social Security and Medicare, to give tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations and to make working families foot the bill, and end the Affordable Care Act.
America has tried these failed policies before. We are not going back.
Generations of Americans before us led the fight for freedom. Now, the baton is in our hands. To protect the right to vote. To get assault weapons off of our streets. To restore reproductive freedom, reversing Donald Trump's extreme abortion bans.
Tim Kaine has spent his entire career fighting to improve the lives of everyday Virginians, and he knows there is more to be done.
If you are ready to join us in the fight for freedom and opportunity for all, please split a donation of $10 to our campaigns. Because when we fight, we win.
Thank you and take care,

I’ll explain more, but if that is all you need to hear, you can make a donation at this link below: [] If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: DONATE $10 [] DONATE $50 [] DONATE $100 [] DONATE OTHER [] In 58 days, Virginia will decide who they want as their next U.S. Senator and their next President. Ultimately, this election is about two different visions for our nation. One focused on the future . And one focused on the past . Tim Kaine and I believe in a future where every person has the opportunity not just to get by, but to get ahead. Where no child has to grow up in poverty. Where every worker has the freedom to join a union. Where every person has affordable health care, child care, and paid leave. Where every senior can retire with dignity. But Donald Trump and his extremist Republican allies want to take our country backward. They intend to cut Social Security and Medicare, to give tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations and to make working families foot the bill, and end the Affordable Care Act. America has tried these failed policies before. We are not going back. Generations of Americans before us led the fight for freedom. Now, the baton is in our hands. To protect the right to vote. To get assault weapons off of our streets. To restore reproductive freedom, reversing Donald Trump's extreme abortion bans. Tim Kaine has spent his entire career fighting to improve the lives of everyday Virginians, and he knows there is more to be done. If you are ready to join us in the fight for freedom and opportunity for all, please split a donation of $10 to our campaigns. Because when we fight, we win. We can’t let billionaires keep buying our elections. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWc-6kVThmY0fQknoUXPWx2uENE_vXElKxZi9q6wiciiO8GEt9uU5CAzMKeCtrzMmVyGuot58CATwJVb-AmcbJI5tq9ibaMOYmUoNtcmVBQawEI1pINCJFFGW-bM5QbqS_hIFsyvpog1CQv3wiiGPZgDf1aIi89tAYULivrWfUNa8ns9t6LWJocs-IsLHSroHf/49l/ko3uhsjoQUmeKakFzcVFQw/h0/h001.r7HfakgOhOjS3l3PTXCPnlydKLRt0G84mHwsKAZUSDw)

Friend, After right-wing group AIPAC spent $12 million to defeat Congresswoman Cori Bush, she said: _“That was just my race, but what will they do next? Because what they’re ultimately trying to do is move Democrats further to the right.”_ Trump-supporting billionaires are using AIPAC to funnel Republican money into Democratic primaries, and they’ve already spent $100 million in this year’s elections. **To make sure our government represents the people rather than billionaires, we desperately need campaign finance reform.** I’ve co-sponsored multiple bills in Congress like the **_Protecting Our Democracy Act_** to hold elected officials accountable and get dark money out of politics, the **_DISCLOSE Act_** _of 2023_ to require additional transparency in elections, and the **_Democracy for All Amendment_** to **overturn**** _Citizens United_** __ and limit corporate campaign spending while encouraging public campaign financing. Public trust in our government has dwindled due to corruption. It’s shameful that some of my colleagues are profiting financially when they vote to support wars and weapons manufacturing. **That’s why I introduced legislation to ban members of Congress from profiting off of war.** **[Can you add your name today to demand Congress pass policies that limit the influence of Big Money in politics and hand the power back to the people?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTJ7RyQRhOYHXeUNck8p79twjAVTrdGCjyrtXJfisYnAOZ4ffxbzXCLd4W-3wU5Gl-GK8Ylq1InkgFZ8KY4J_8J1jMEljeQaNnKwICByer-oA2lmoRe9vQH8TlXH88uTzuSmxYKX_iAfQdykc6U-k3c25DJn4cgqbfup_Tf-VGRQTy2iXMx7Wcm3gWSLWvDfkwUFpp2SzkBOAwVd3RDHxCscO2GMpT_is_nIiNbUnyw0C14ChHJJCLXQeOOOT4x1qDA2shSAJsSzlqY7USmBjz3P_ioTfTq8q6Txs_Lo__kR1h9Go0rdENcTKiJWs09kgvLF_VwVzbEyTYCpCsviBx4FWBLlRBJwn8K1LjHlcPUEw7nIt0t6dJmrN5u7wUn1-htz02Qo0HFXhb_z-yXjm4Ro/49l/ko3uhsjoQUmeKakFzcVFQw/h1/h001.V6x7UFLfj2Y0x8MMcTikcNfJOT7X_j9ZpbSWVc0lYV8)** | [SIGN NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTJ7RyQRhOYHXeUNck8p79twjAVTrdGCjyrtXJfisYnAOZ4ffxbzXCLd4W-3wU5Gl-GK8Ylq1InkgFZ8KY4J_8J1jMEljeQaNnKwICByer-oA2lmoRe9vQH8TlXH88uTzuSmxYKX_iAfQdykc6U-k3c33MKYYmiV4c1Dk5J2-PFpGlwuljgWL-LMtwbrolJ2Bt7ZzqEEK2yuAPoA4ahbPbLRXC1zPz67IaoQBxmLATPeWDJBk7rHgPT5qAZRg-BvKE-zxa5cb83rvUjqJUcqa3qwin359agXp0bu4_eiEJIEWctYEOX1VOKyA1vv1wAQ3vmYi2J2heEIFt6ZzOnZ6Q2OxXGWCAla7255ti03bG02mB2FHKVDmcBYfRrriev7p2Pvz_8w7AT9SFP6UWLYJU6w/49l/ko3uhsjoQUmeKakFzcVFQw/h2/h001.ZPQcl_1aiwq3zH7YDxEyOKqG1t6Itp94R9jJGIwFy1Y)

**Thank you for taking action to demand our elected officials represent the people rather than corporate and Big Money interests.**
For many years, Americans have been losing trust in government and feeling unheard by the people who are supposed to represent them. In a recent poll, more than 8 in 10 U.S. adults agreed that “special interest groups and lobbyists have too much say in what happens in politics” and**** “the cost of political campaigns makes it hard for good people to run for office.”
These costs keep going up, partly because AIPAC keeps spending unprecedented amounts of money from its Trump-supporting donors. A coalition of progressive organizations like the Movement for Black Lives and the Working Families Party joined to form “Reject AIPAC,” which recently wrote to the Democratic National Committee to demand the Democratic Party and candidates refuse endorsements and contributions from AIPAC.
But it’s not just about AIPAC. **Powerful special interests want to keep rigging the system in their favor, and they’re escalating their efforts because they’re afraid of our progressive movement to change the unjust status quo.**
**[Please add your name to tell Congress: Stop far-right billionaires from spending more and more to buy our elections. It’s time to pass policies to limit Big Money in our politics and hand the power back to the people.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTJ7RyQRhOYHXeUNck8p79twjAVTrdGCjyrtXJfisYnAOZ4ffxbzXCLd4W-3wU5Gl-GK8Ylq1InkgFZ8KY4J_8J1jMEljeQaNnKwICByer-oA2lmoRe9vQH8TlXH88uTzuSmxYKX_iAfQdykc6U-k3c3vEXC1-Qk57B2Yiev2pqQKaa0UI5PAm0tkbBy_8CIzEFJaevYt7lieleqq_gNI8mAAHKopJJOwzOJiBb_KODfh_k0eBe60pTqz2IV2gXwisJgMPdLmZJ-zBl4S1V_5Lzh4LW9UI-BvRbQE8WbQKE942MeC1Qkd_L7OYrGfZbLKGdWl37KMDxGYBobMrbV0zu5AFNk91Sbgq_cW6TAeRaGKi146slqTeTQWxqxvJlfJyigjsxCvMzyXQ4Q6H2r9lCk/49l/ko3uhsjoQUmeKakFzcVFQw/h3/h001.NWaFWE9mISrNDflccfxn7rHsiDxskl3sIK8JdS6POIs)**
Together, we’ll keep fighting for a government by and for the people, where everyone can thrive.
In solidarity,
Rashida

From: **Rashida Tlaib******
Date: Sat, Sep 7, 2024
Subject: AIPAC spent more than $100 million on 2024’s elections so far
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
Friend,
Anti-Palestinian lobbying group AIPAC pledged to spend $100 million influencing 2024’s elections, and they’ve already surpassed that amount.
Funded mainly by far-right billionaires, AIPAC spent $30 million this summer to unseat two of the most progressive members of Congress, making Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush’s congressional primary elections the most expensive in U.S. history.
**This influx of billionaire spending drowns out the voices of everyday voters, making it virtually impossible for working-class candidates to run for office and win.**
**Already, more than half of members of Congress are millionaires.** They can’t relate to the struggles of ordinary Americans, and they don’t understand how quickly we need bold changes to end poverty and ensure that everyone can thrive.
In a recent poll, more than 8 in 10 U.S. adults reported that “special interest groups and lobbyists have too much say in what happens in politics.” This level of influence—powered by Big Money interests—erodes our democracy and blocks much-needed progress.

name: John Fetterman
subject: Bringing housing costs down 🏠
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Supply just isn’t keeping up with demand.
#
Housing prices are rising and rent is climbing, Derek.
Supply just isn’t keeping up with demand, and it’s making it way too hard for people in PA + across the country to pay the bills. **And you know what’s one of the main barriers to increasing the housing supply?**
_Restrictive zoning codes._ 🚫🏠
Overly restrictive regulations at the state and local level are making it way too hard to build, and now we have a shortage of nearly **four million units** nationwide to show for it.
That’s why I just introduced the _Reducing Regulatory Barriers to Housing Act_ in the Senate. We’re going to help communities cut that red tape, change those zoning codes, build more units, and bring costs down.
I’m doing everything I can to bring costs down for Pennsylvanians; introducing this bill is just the first step. Now, we’ve got to get it passed and signed into law.
[**Derek, to keep doing this work for everyday Pennsylvanians, I need your support. Pitch in $5 to my campaign today and help me keep PA + the Senate blue.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240908?refcode=em20240908-9361&refcode2=9361_434096_Gap6bQ&akid=9361%2E434096%2EGap6bQ)
