This is what (rural) Democracy looks like!
After the City of Rome, New York, had rescheduled their July Honor America Days Parade due to extensive tornado damage, we marched, undeterred, in pouring rain. Afterwards, we gathered with other candidates at a local brewery, and later at a park for an ice cream social. We were cold, drenched, but joyous. This is what Democracy looks like in rural, upstate New York.
Several people have asked, "How's the campaign going?"
There is no easy way to answer this.
I'm privileged to run against one of the top Republican House leaders, Elise Stefanik. If this were a race in an urban district, I'm sure there would have been at least 3 other Democrats clamoring to try to get on the ballot. Instead, I'm the only Democrat whose campaign was sufficiently viable to survive to land on the ticket for November.
We're broke. But we are laser-focused on making a difference not just for this race, but for the races after 2024.
New York's 21st Congressional District has all or part of 15 counties, spread over 15,000 square miles. There are basically four population centers: Rome has 31,735 residents. Plattsburgh has 19,904. Glens Falls has 14,830 , combined with Queensbury, which has 29,140. Canton has 11,638 nearby Potsdam has 8,312.
Beyond that, the district consists of summer camps in the beautiful Adirondack Park, suburban country villages, and miles and miles of agricultural and small manufacturing enclaves. Lots of family-owned farms. Many town, villages, and hamlets have more cows than people. The other night we were driving home from an event and we went more than 2 hours on a dark county road without encountering a single other car.
Some days, my team and I drive 3 hours to an event where I speak for 5 minutes. We talk to any voters whom we can meet. Then we pile back in the car and drive back 3 hours.
Other days, we are on the road at 6:30am to drive hours through wind and rain, stand on our feet for hours, and then find a nice warm place to get a meal, and decompress before driving home to arrive after midnight.
We meet in small town theatres, libraries, town parks, VFW Halls, and town festivals. We march in parades. We knock on doors. We even talk to voters in gas station parking lots. If you know upstate New York, you know Stewart's. We have some amazing talks with voters at the pump or when we go inside. Thank goodness they always have hot coffee.
We are meeting with voters at pubs and restaurants. There are some people - even if they vote blue - who will never turn up at something called a "Democratic committee meeting". But they will turn up to have a beverage and talk with neighbors.
We have sent out close to 200,000 postcards and are still cranking them out. If nothing else, the postcards - which we are not sending through a direct mail provider - have inspired literally hundreds of volunteers to do something this cycle for Democracy. That's saying something. When I first started postcarding, I ordered a box of 10,000 cards. It took me 7 weeks to find enough volunteers to put labels and stamps on them. Last week, we had a shipment of 50,000 get distributed in 3 days, and we had volunteers asking for more. This - in a rural district in which I routinely hear the phrase, "Closet Democrat".
People are finally starting to nod when I say, I hope we can lose that term, "Closet Democrat." Because, as our Democratic Presidential Nominee has said: we're not going back.
In NY-21, we're not going back to the days when people are afraid to let their neighbors know that they vote Democrat.
We're not going back to the days when we have rosters of open seats, and no Democratic candidate to run against the MAGA incumbent, or worse, against the newbie, inexperienced MAGA who has the full, blind support of the party.
We're not going back to having people afraid to put out a yard sign that says, "Vote" for a non-MAGA candidate. Admittedly - that fear won't go away overnight, but it's a whole lot better now than it was over the summer.
NY-21 is not going back to having Democrats who have the courage to show up to Democratic Committee meetings only to tell the candidate that the race is "unwinnable" or that they are afraid to try anything because their town is surrounded by a "sea of red."
No - we're not going back. New York 21 is not going back.
Nope. At a bar-bones minimum, this is the year we start to turn the tide.
It won't be easy. But we have one way to lose and three ways to win.
We lose if we cave in to what I have called, "Democratic Despair" and do nothing but stay at home and watch YouTube videos of the DNC speeches.
But we have three ways to win. First, we win by getting the most votes. That's a long shot. But it may happen. And my team members have promised that they will be insufferable to those who doubted us if we happen to ride the coattails of the top of the ticket and score a win. I chuckle, but it could happen.
We also win by turning this bright red district a little bit purple. And we win by getting our organization, volunteers, and processes in place for the midterms.
There is new energy. New courage. People who, four weeks ago, were covert about accepting 30 postcards to send out, are now asking me if they can have a yard sign. Seriously. Same people have newly found their power. It's beautiful to watch.
[Please send support.](https://substack.com/redirect/6b384039-4d11-439a-9ef7-b4fde9a1b884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Look, my text window blows up every ten minutes with requests from races, just like yours does. But the down-ballot boost that the Harris Campaign is sharing with other Congressional races is likely not going to trickle down to this campaign. The county committees are contributing what they can, but they are broke, too. We have some support from a few PACs, but those contributions combined total less than $5,000.
It's up to us. Your support makes it possible for us to put another yard sign in the ground, another banner on a barn or fence, and to put gas in the car to drive another mile.
We are in it to win it. When we fight, we win. And guess what - we're already winning!
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

| Can I tell you a story about my family farm, Folks? [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92412885/497026702/-1178903559?refcode=em-9.8.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMGYyMzI5Yi1mNzZkLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pJ1HF-LPQxJWMJK3vgmIBLLSBkSPL_8NtKNYrPc_2Eg=) In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began. He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later. We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage. The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day. When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet. **These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.** **[I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. clean_body: | Can I tell you a story about my family farm, Folks? = In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began. He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later. We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage. The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day. When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. body:
Someone who is wrong for the White House
|
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92413815/497029527/1944926606?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_Vance_240908_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjBmY2YwNy1mYTZkLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V-1uqdXIDxAHy2UNne78AcUU6EdmQctqbZxOG7D4A38=) Team,

Growing up in Georgetown, Ohio, I learned that there are certain values you’re likely to see in most rural Ohioans.

We respect authenticity – _which means we can spot a phony when we see one_. We believe in the dignity of hard work – but we do know there are situations where we just need a little help, which is why **we are ALWAYS willing to support our neighbors.**

Donald Trump’s VP pick, Ohio Senator J.D. Vance, stands in stark contrast. He doesn’t represent the people I know from home. In a moment, I’m going to ask if you can [_**chip in to support the Ohio Dems in this historic election year,**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92413816/497029528/1944926606?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_Vance_240908_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjBmY2YwNy1mYTZkLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V-1uqdXIDxAHy2UNne78AcUU6EdmQctqbZxOG7D4A38=) but first, let me tell you why I am confident J.D. Vance is wrong for Ohio and wrong for the White House.

J.D. Vance’s career has been built on a phony image. His opportunism and lack of authenticity is what drove him from being a firm critic of Donald Trump to becoming one of his biggest supporters and ultimately, his VP pick. In 2016, Vance called himself a “Never Trump guy.” Of course when he ran for Senate in Ohio in 2021 and wanted Trump’s endorsement, he changed his tune. This cowardly flip-flopping is exactly the type of phony self-promotion that rural voters can see a mile away.

But he’s not _just_ limited to flip-flopping. Vance built his political brand by shaming working-class families, sucking up to billionaires, and voting against working people every chance he got.

Hello,
After the 2022 election, my husband Adam Frisch and I went to Washington for “freshman orientation” for new members of Congress.
We still didn’t know whether or not Adam had defeated Lauren Boebert. We were in the middle of a recount – and Adam was down by only a few hundred votes.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92414795/497033152/1610638071?refcode=em20240908mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=aa3ec061-fb6d-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTNlYzA2MS1mYjZkLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yXdBkG6b6RbOGTbCHQ2s7cGnkhS-dPuIz3WFHYrg2Rc=)

Now, Adam’s running again in 2024 – and with Lauren Boebert now out of the race, I know he can win this time. But first, we have to fix the reason he so narrowly lost in 2022.
**During the last campaign, we got out-spent – by millions and millions of dollars.** It wasn’t that we didn’t put in the work (we did). It wasn’t that Adam didn’t have a positive vision for the district (he does). We were just drowned out in millions of dollars of lie-filled attack ads.
**If Adam’s going to be able to finish the job and win this critical House seat, we cannot afford to get out-spent again – and we’re counting on your help now.**
**We’ve set a goal to raise another $25,000 before our fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, but right now, we still have $7,850 left to raise.**

clean_body: During the last campaign, we got out-spent – by millions and millions of dollars. Hello, After the 2022 election, my husband Adam Frisch and I went to Washington for “freshman orientation” for new members of Congress. We still didn’t know whether or not Adam had defeated Lauren Boebert. We were in the middle of a recount – and Adam was down by only a few hundred votes. = Ultimately, though, after all the votes were counted, Adam came up short. We lost to Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. Now, Adam’s running again in 2024 – and with Lauren Boebert now out of the race, I know he can win this time. But first, we have to fix the reason he so narrowly lost in 2022. During the last campaign, we got out-spent – by millions and millions of dollars. It wasn’t that we didn’t put in the work (we did). It wasn’t that Adam didn’t have a positive vision for the district (he does). We were just drowned out in millions of dollars of lie-filled attack ads. If Adam’s going to be able to finish the job and win this critical House seat, we cannot afford to get out-spent again – and we’re counting on your help now. We’ve set a goal to raise another $25,000 before our fundraising deadline at midnight tonight, but right now, we still have $7,850 left to raise. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I’ll admit, the first campaign was hard – for the whole family. But we’re all-in win this November. Thank you for being on this journey with us, Katy ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. I don’t want to give it too much attention, but Trump spoke in Arizona twice last week, including one time with my opponent, Kari Lake, at a rally in Phoenix.

He laid out his cynical and divisive worldview for the millionth time. He spoke about his extreme, radical, dangerous agenda. And he put us — our campaign — square in the middle of his warpath. He attacked me multiple times, said I "shouldn't even be allowed to run."

But most importantly, he said if he wins in Arizona he wins the presidency. He said it himself: He has to go straight through us to have any chance at winning this November.

But I’ve got a message for him: **Show some respect.** [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/50386?t=7&akid=22011%2E4449941%2EjtIAAo) After years of attacking and insulting veterans like John McCain, or Gold Star Parents like the Khans, the fallen of Belleau Wood, even Medal of Honor recipients — show some respect for the military, for veterans, and for our families.

**We’ve got your number, Donald. And we will not let you win.**

This election is going to come down to Trump and Lake versus you and me. Can I count on you to have my back as I take the fight to them from now until November? [**If you’re still with me, please, make a split $10 donation with Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats and my campaign to support our work out in Arizona. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: We really need a boost, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
My campaign team encouraged me to reach out because right now, we’re behind pace on our quarterly fundraising goal.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240908-4268-footer&t=1&akid=4268%2E420207%2EuANjB7)
Peter,
My campaign team encouraged me to reach out because right now, we’re behind pace on our quarterly fundraising goal. That’s important (and concerning) for a few reasons.
We need strong fundraising so that I can campaign in full force for Democrats in swing districts and progressives running to expand support for Medicare for All in Congress. And my fight to codify abortion rights, raise the minimum wage to at least $15, nix the filibuster, and pass humane immigration reform is fueled by your support, Peter.
[**So we’re setting a quick, 24 hour goal to get us back on track. Can you chip in $3 to help us raise $7,500 in the next 24 hours?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240908?refcode=em20240908&amount=3&refcode2=4268_420207_uANjB7&akid=4268%2E420207%2EuANjB7)
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240908?amount=3&refcode=em20240908-4268&refcode2=4268_420207_uANjB7&akid=4268%2E420207%2EuANjB7)**
And I really do rely on your donations, Peter.
The average online donation to my campaign this year is just $39.77. The majority of folks donating in response to emails like this one give even less. So, I really do need folks to step up today so we can hit our goal.
When the quarterly FEC filing deadline comes at the end of this month, it’s also important because our fundraising numbers will go public. Reporters, DC insiders, and our opponents will look at my fundraising numbers as a measure of the strength of the progressive movement. subject: A quick request (not asking for money)
body:
This is a big week.
---
Derek, We’re reaching out with a quick request today -- and no, it’s not for money: [**Will you take two minutes to endorse Kamala Harris for president, Tim Walz for vice president, and Democrats running for seats up and down the ballot? _I believe that workers’ rights should be expanded, and unions given more power to collectively bargain, but Hogan disagrees._

**He vetoed a law that would have allowed workers to deduct union dues from state income taxes.**

_I believe that we can and should be doing more to improve the lives of working Marylanders, but again, Hogan disagrees._

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Peter,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

But even still, it was a struggle to pay the bills and afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
When I turned 15, I got a job at a local doughnut shop. **It was hard work, but it's what my family needed to make ends meet.**
I'm not the only one who got their start in the doughnut business. When he was a young man, my opponent, Rick Scott, **_bought_** two doughnut shops.

While I was a teen making minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, Rick Scott was an owner.

I went on to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. Rick Scott went on to oversee the largest Medicare fraud in the nation’s history, amass a fortune of hundreds of millions, and buy a Senate seat.

Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e4c8615cc7c04c3496c1ea3a4b047200&_e=jS1oaU-Up-yVuHTSDgs0UPNpaXtAsaweKav_VhiRgbtcqcRfmjd7lqv_Bi7suHsZ0x6IYtLCryozAR-Pb3wjeLppN_yIi_OY8hvHrCPtzRXS1bcVFdxI_Y3qY-hciO8cmDt4TnfVMOH_tdMqBvEu_0WCPvqt7KkzkyxWDnQ13N2tz81dNKQ0I0wUJYMPgqgLcfmUxkCq2WVmouqLb0IcLBBMgbc7MXdd7UJJoQ7me9aloApZpleAQ7dNfvAWKBYT68TnLd5JtbGxt8HhvLvjVP3Dp7bcsI9KsW8G8kxLiYKjk6sBucV7AfFcvM0x5YXMeh_QZc5PEPsNDsOAcrDPDwqyg6gxkBpiEG8TjFB_MexdQJ8h_MwIZLA3dJgVyc4X2qpXt5FXnkwCs2tEThV30UbyfHpdwcBQmGAlsllKJqY%3D)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e4c8615cc7c04c3496c1ea3a4b047200&_e=jS1oaU-Up-yVuHTSDgs0UPNpaXtAsaweKav_VhiRgbtcqcRfmjd7lqv_Bi7suHsZ0x6IYtLCryozAR-Pb3wjeLppN_yIi_OY8hvHrCPtzRXS1bcVFdxI_Y3qY-hciO8cmDt4TnfVMOH_tdMqBvEu_0WCPvqt7KkzkyxWDnQ13N2tz81dNKQ0I0wUJYMPgqgLcfmUxkCq2WVmouqLb0IcLBBMgbc7MXdd7UJJoQ7me9aloApZpleAQ7dNfvAWKBYTuBbWo5UxrtJnt8IcGsnHsnCnBjfFZseJKEw9Av5UgDEPg07634xD_qUKrtxgtuk7SIGhPy85pTUUmYVKJRMmcfEN6IbxrpoLWy4JAN1b-OuXpwumvVX3PNAIn6Nhq4ryHkcaV93ojZqRC8MzPQpKg7cEdh2VdPltczGKD2k2Ds4%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e4c8615cc7c04c3496c1ea3a4b047200&_e=jS1oaU-Up-yVuHTSDgs0UPNpaXtAsaweKav_VhiRgbtcqcRfmjd7lqv_Bi7suHsZ0x6IYtLCryozAR-Pb3wjeLppN_yIi_OY8hvHrCPtzRXS1bcVFdxI_Y3qY-hciO8cmDt4TnfVMOH_tdMqBvEu_0WCPvqt7KkzkyxWDnQ13N2tz81dNKQ0I0wUJYMPgqgLcfmUxkCq2WVmouqLb0IcLBBMgbc7MXdd7UJJoQ7me9aloApZpleAQ7dNfvAWKBYT_ENT8RevB-wITJkP4gOSfW0j4yrLXvXqtnf-wwo1edN9QTQpiO8nIMnTQ_GWx2KDSZZrjsvgPh0bVsckTSNwLyXa1KSvXBYBWOm7sRs-_t2h4CZuY6qy-gE359Z90Z-jNfkMQd0xmYaUraHpQcGjNteSTdhspHs4JlC--HP6t2c%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re under 60 days away from the most competitive election of our lives in the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country.

Hi Peter,
Since he took office, we’ve seen Juan Ciscomani choose partisanship over his constituents time and time again.
But this pattern makes sense when you look at his record before taking office in 2023.
While Kirsten was working on a deal to protect Arizona’s water future in the state legislature, Ciscomani was helping sell our water to farms in Saudi Arabia.
While Kirsten was fighting to protect reproductive freedom, Ciscomani was vetting the Arizona Supreme Court judges who would later reinstate the 1864 abortion ban.
And while Kirsten was trying to pass gun safety laws — so no child has to feel unsafe in their classroom — Ciscomani was helping lead a Christian nationalist organization that arms children as young as 11.
Kirsten and Ciscomani both worked for the Arizona government, but it’s clear who actually worked for the people.
Since he took office, Ciscomani has supported cutting jobs in our district, blocked the bipartisan border bill, and voted to restrict access to abortion. He’s shown he cares more about MAGA than the folks back home.
In two months, we can vote Ciscomani out of office for good.

The mass shootings need to stop, Peter. It shouldn't be our normal to have a new mass shooting every week; another massive loss of life, another entire town made to feel unsafe, and another school population traumatized. Republicans would have you believe that this is just the way the cookie crumbles, that there's nothing we can do about it, and that any action that prevents these tragedies would infringe upon Second Amendment rights. Frankly, Republicans have no desire to do anything about the mass death that is traumatizing our nation's children. Kamala Harris is different though. She is supporting common sense gun safety solutions like background checks, assault weapons bans, tighter regulations on gun sales, and more. She is standing up for the safety of our kids and communities. That is how we can prevent the massacres that happen on a monthly basis in our country. Did you see what Trump had to say about it? When asked directly about what a second Trump administration will do about it, he beat around the bush, he trailed off on different nothingburger claims, and he simply had nothing of consequence to offer the American people as a solution for the senseless violence. name: David Hogg (Leaders We Deserve)
subject: change IS possible
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-lwd?refcode=240908em-change [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-lwd?refcode=240908em-change]
The reason change doesn’t happen is not because it’s impossible — but because people think it is impossible .
I believe this idea that change is impossible is the single greatest threat to American democracy. Before I tell you more, can you take a moment to support our mission to elect young, progressive leaders by splitting a small donation with Tobias Read and Leaders We Deserve? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-lwd?refcode=240908em-change]
After Parkland, many adults said:
“What happened is terrible and it’s amazing you kids are standing up, but you’ll never change anything because this is Florida. ”
But guess what?
Outraged students and parents of victims — like Fred Guttenberg and Manuel Oliver — said we don’t care; we’re still going to try. We showed up and protested by the thousands in Tallahassee. And guess what? We actually did change gun laws. We raised the age to buy guns in Florida to 21 and passed a red flag law.
Later, my mother got a death threat from an NRA supporter who said: “F with the NRA, and you’ll be DOA.”
We used the law we passed after Parkland to disarm the man who threatened to kill my mother, and since the passage of that law, over 12,000 other people who were a risk to themselves or others have been disarmed.
Look, if we didn’t have the audacity to hope – I may have had to bury my own mother. That’s why I’m still fighting to keep others safe from gun violence. Can you split $20 between Tobias Read and Leaders We Deserve to support the work we’re doing to create a safer future? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-lwd?refcode=240908em-change]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-lwd?refcode=240908em-change]
A few years later, I hired a young guy named Maxwell Frost from my freshman dorm room in college to be the March for Our Lives National Organizing Director. In my junior year of college, he called me up and said he would have to leave March for Our Lives because he wanted to run for Congress and asked for my help.
Before this, I hadn’t really helped anyone run for office in a major way because I didn’t trust politicians who only wanted to use me to get elected and then do nothing about gun violence.
But I didn’t see Maxwell as a politician – I saw him as a friend, so I did everything I could to help him run.
Once again, I heard the same thing from professors and “experts”:
“He’s too young.”
“He doesn’t have the political or donor connections to win.”
“How is he going to win against two former members of Congress?”
I didn’t care and decided to keep supporting him because I knew what an incredible leader he could be, and I wanted to prove everyone who said it wasn’t possible wrong. So, I helped Maxwell raise $380,000 in his first two quarters, which helped him win by a margin of 10% — and he became the youngest member of Congress.
Once elected, Maxwell’s first bill was to create a Federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention (something March for Our Lives had been pushing for over three years) and within 1 year of his election, Maxwell was introducing the President of the United States, who was announcing the creation of the Office of Gun Violence Prevention. That office has overseen a 20% reduction of gun homicides in the first quarter of 2024.
If we listened to the people who said Maxwell couldn’t win, and if he didn’t bother to try, we wouldn’t have:
*
The
youngest
and
first
Gen
Z
member
of
Congress;
*
an
Office
of
Gun
Violence
Prevention;
*
first
member
of
March
for
Our
Lives
in
Congress.
We’re changing the status quo and getting more young leaders elected to office. Can you donate $20 between Tobias Read and Leaders We Deserve to fuel our work to elect young progressives up and down the ballot? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-lwd?refcode=240908em-change]
We are in a vicious cycle of cynicism and hopelessness that will destroy us if we don’t break it. Hopelessness is a self-fulfilling prophecy. If we never think things can get better, they never will.
That’s why – with Maxwell’s campaign manager, Kevin Lata – we created Leaders We Deserve. An organization dedicated to funding and advising the best Democrats of our generation to get them elected, so we can have leaders in office that will inspire young people to vote.
Our candidates are pro-gun reform, pro-choice, and pro-environment. They also don’t take money from large corporations and neither does Leaders We Deserve.
Just recently, we spent $300,000 supporting Molly Cook, who won by just 62 votes and is now the youngest member of the Texas Senate.
CHANGE IS POSSIBLE! And we’re making it happen.
Join the thousands of people supporting a better, more progressive future. We rely on grassroots support to get young progressives elected to office, and with November 5 getting closer, we need a big surge of donations to get across the finish line.
Can we count on you to split $20 between Tobias Read and Leaders We Deserve to support the work we’re doing to build a better future for the next generation? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-lwd?refcode=240908em-change]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-lwd?refcode=240908em-change]
We’re in this fight together.
Thank you,
David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve
Tobias Read is running for Oregon Secretary of State to bring real change to our state. To support him directly, please donate here. [https://www.tobiasread.com]
Leaders We Deserve is a grassroots organization dedicated to electing young progressives to Congress and State Legislatures nationwide. You can support them directly here. [https://leaderswedeserve.com/]

It will take you less than a minute to complete, but the impact of your responses will have far-reaching benefits. With one of our best rosters of Republican Senate recruits, your insight helps us be as effective as possible in our messaging and strategy.

But here's the bad news, Fellow American. Democrats are outraising our candidates and Republican Senators by millions. Resources will be stretched thin, and if we don't catch up, our candidates could lose in November.

body:
Tammy Baldwin here — I wanted to make sure you saw this message from my
colleague, Jon Tester. Jon is running for reelection in Montana to defend
our Democratic Senate majority, so I hope you'll read his message and
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-tester.Z0aSwr&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240908_PM1_V1_S1&t=1003&akid=3609%2E35263%2EmtiE6g ]chip in if you can.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Can I tell you a story about my family farm,
Peter?

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-tester.Z0aSwr&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240908_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=3609%2E35263%2EmtiE6g ]Jon Tester on the farm

In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land,
took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the
farm began.

He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my
folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still
here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.

We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several
steel buildings, and more storage.

The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late
nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me
grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.

When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like
mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of
flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the
people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail
delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think
about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need
access to affordable, high-speed internet.

These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real
challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for
in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working
families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the
country.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-tester.Z0aSwr&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240908_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=3609%2E35263%2EmtiE6g ]I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just
like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to
something, I see it through. Can you make a split donation of any amount
between Tammy Baldwin and my campaign today to help me keep up the fight
in Washington?

I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the
right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you
get a whole lot less.

That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a
support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what
this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over
these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready.

I appreciate anything you’re able to pitch in. Thanks for your help, and I
hope I make you proud.

—Jon

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: It’s been a wild few months. Thanks for sticking with me.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Think back to this point in June, before our last official FEC deadline. Arizona was a toss-up, Trump was leading, and we were in a close race with Kari Lake.
#

A longer email than normal from me today, Peter. Please, hang around if you have a minute.
I want you to think back to this point in June, before our last official FEC deadline. **Arizona was a toss-up, Trump was leading, and we were neck-and-neck with Kari Lake.**
Since then, there was an assassination attempt on a former President of the United States. The Republican National Convention happened. Joe Biden stepped aside, and Kamala Harris took the nomination. We had our own primary election and Kari Lake officially became our opponent. Just two weeks ago was our own convention.
It’s hard to believe, but that was all in the last three months. Thanks for sticking with me through them.
Now, the dust has settled a little after the DNC, and here’s where things stand with two months to go:**Arizona is a toss-up, Trump is leading, and we are neck-and-neck with Kari Lake.**
We’ve done everything right so far. No big mistakes, no unforced errors, and a ton of fresh enthusiasm and momentum over the last two or three months. We weathered some big changes, and that’s thanks to the strong team we’ve built together.
But all of the enthusiasm, all the momentum, it’s not enough to win this race. It’s going to take real, sustained, hard work. And because our Senate race is just underneath the presidential race on the ballot that folks will be voting on, the outcome of that campaign could absolutely affect the outcome of our own race.
Every ad we run, every call we make, every door we knock, every dollar we raise — all of that makes a difference in a campaign as close as this one, and we have to be ready for whatever comes next. If the last three months are any indication, the next two are going to be a wild ride.
[**So, after all of that, I have to ask you: Will you chip in $5 to my campaign for U.S. Senate and help me hold the line and defend Arizona against Kari Lake and Donald Trump?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept24.kTsNbj&refcode=em240908-2-160&t=1&akid=3033%2E734936%2EFz1Qlh)

Hi Friend, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
[**If you already know why we need Elissa Slotkin in the U.S. Senate, click here right now—really, every dollar helps!—and have a great rest of your night!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240908-2-900&t=3&akid=1889%2E135344%2EKMAG16)
Elissa is an incredible candidate with a compelling story. You might know that she served three tours in Iraq alongside our military before working in national security under two presidents. But I want to share with you some of our recent conversations in which I learned why being a public servant is personal for Elissa.
After comforting families and survivors of not just one but two school shootings in Michigan (Oxford and Michigan State University), Elissa became even more fierce in her determination to stop the #1 killer of children in the United States: gun violence.
“People protested against seat belts in the 80s,” she told me, “but common sense prevailed, and millions of lives have been saved. We need to get this done!”
We CAN get this done if we elect people like Elissa who aren’t beholden to the gun lobby. People with common sense. People who care.

Carole

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Less than 2 days
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Let’s close this gap and win this thing!
#
We've got less than 2 days to win this.
Just 2 days to lock in the Democratic nomination. Just 2 days to take one big step towards electing the first openly trans member of Congress. Just 2 days to get closer to sending a champion for families, kids, and working people to the House.
**We're on the cusp of something big.**
**But my team has also been crunching the numbers — and we need to raise $10,000 from emails like this to reach the voters we need before the polls close on Tuesday night.**
[**So, if you are fired up to win in the next 2 days, please pitch in $5 or whatever you can. Let's close this gap and win this thing!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240908-1?refcode=em20240908-1-1158&amount=5&refcode2=1158_21716_CTCBxy&akid=1158%2E21716%2ECTCBxy)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240908-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240908-1-1158&refcode2=1158_21716_CTCBxy&akid=1158%2E21716%2ECTCBxy)**
We know folks might think, "Oh it's Delaware. It's safe." But we've seen complacency tank campaigns (hello, 2016), and winning this primary by a wide margin puts us in the best position possible heading into the general election in November.
The far-right has already attacked me because of my identity. And there has NEVER been an openly transgender member of Congress — if it was so easy to do, it would already be done.
So, we can't take anything for granted.
We have to put everything we've got into the next 2 days to make sure we win the primary and have the momentum to win in November.
[**Please pitch in $5 or more to close our $10,000 gap before Tuesday night.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240908-1?refcode=em20240908-1-1158&amount=5&refcode2=1158_21716_CTCBxy&akid=1158%2E21716%2ECTCBxy)
Thanks for all you've done to have my back!
Sarah McBride

Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92424252/497065566/-1736033032?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5376-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmQ5NTM1Ni0xNzZlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AFbVKCILWLRzlFsODSSgUgorCi4KKpupz5Xg_k94QAQ=)
I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment.
But friend, my mom never wavered once. **Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life.**
I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family.
**Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort.** There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems. But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me.
My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. **These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort.**
Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to end them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs.
**Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. That's why I'm running for Senate — to fight for people like my mom.** **_[Polls show that we've got a real chance to win, but I'm counting on your help to power my grassroots campaign. Please, if you believe in a better future for seniors, will you rush $5 to split between me and Kirsten Gillibrand to help me defeat Rick Scott and protect Social Security and Medicare?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92424253/497065567/-1736033032?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk5376-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmQ5NTM1Ni0xNzZlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AFbVKCILWLRzlFsODSSgUgorCi4KKpupz5Xg_k94QAQ=)_**

clean_body: | | | Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life. = I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment. But friend, my mom never wavered once. Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life. I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family. Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort. There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems. But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me. My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort. Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to end them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs. Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. That's why I'm running for Senate — to fight for people like my mom. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you so much, Debbie | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

body:
Ashwin Ramaswami is the best of us -- I’d love to tell you why.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240908&t=1&akid=1157%2E587540%2ES3nx_J)
Peter,
Picture this: An election between an indicted Trump fake elector vs. a 24 year old software engineer who worked with the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency to secure our elections.
Sometimes truth really is stranger than fiction — but that’s the election happening in the most competitive races in Georgia, and it’s why we have to help elect **Ashwin Ramaswami.**
And we know Georgia only really has “competitive” races because of the work and dedication of young people just like us. For years Republicans have been stacking extremist candidates in these local races who eventually make it up statewide or federal offices. **We have to stop this right here, right now.**
**[A donation of $5 to Leaders We Deserve does just that: Build the bench and fight back against election denialism by investing to elect Ashwin Ramaswami right now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240908?refcode=em20240908&amount=5&refcode2=1157_587540_S3nx_J&akid=1157%2E587540%2ES3nx_J)**
Ashwin’s fake elector opponent claims he had no idea what happened in 2020, and that he was just a “good soldier who did what he was told to do.”
Don’t believe a word of it. Republicans are building their bench on useful idiots just like this, in the hopes that they’ll do just that — what they’re told. **We’ve seen the playbook, and we know what’s at stake, which is why electing someone like Ashwin is so important to protecting our democracy.**
Ashwin is the best of us, the best of Gen-Z: Instead of taking a high-paying, private-industry tech job, Ashwin is committing himself to public service (to the tune of a $23,000 public servant salary). He’ll fight for commonsense laws to support everyday Americans, from gun violence to abortion to education.
He’s exactly the type of person who we need to win in these critical, bench-building races.
**[Invest in Ashwin and the future of the Democratic party today by donating $5 or more to Leaders We Deserve right now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240908?refcode=em20240908&amount=5&refcode2=1157_587540_S3nx_J&akid=1157%2E587540%2ES3nx_J)**

Thanks,
David Hogg

body:
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/30946?t=1009&amount=25&akid=2436%2E52803%2EfZfy0M ][IMG]

Peter, this is probably the longest email you’ll ever get from
me.

But it’s also one of the most important, so it really would mean a lot to
me if you could read through it.

If you’re in a hurry or if you’re already sold and ready to do whatever it
takes to help me defeat Larry Hogan and defend our Senate majority,
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/30946?t=1010&amount=25&akid=2436%2E52803%2EfZfy0M ]then please consider making a quick grassroots contribution to give us
the resources and momentum to win this race in less than 9 weeks!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/30946?t=1011&amount=25&akid=2436%2E52803%2EfZfy0M ]Donate

I want to outline our campaign message going forward for the General
Election to fill Maryland’s open U.S. Senate seat. It hinges on 3 major
components:

Power to the People

This campaign has never been about me,
Peter. It’s always been about
Marylanders, our families, and our communities.

And when Republican Larry Hogan entered the race putting our Democratic
Senate majority at risk, it became about the future of the entire country.

That’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race. But
during the Democratic Primary, we proved that Maryland is won by the many,
not by the money.

We’ve never had limitless resources, million dollar checks, or shady dark
money super PACs pulling the strings. Instead, we built a grassroots
coalition of people in every corner of the state who stepped up to
volunteer, donate, and talk to their neighbors about our campaign.

Your time and your contributions were the driving force behind our primary
victory, and we need to continue building on that in order to win in
November.

Focus on the Issues that Matter

While Republicans are lining up to get behind Donald Trump and his
divisive MAGA agenda, we're focusing on the issues that matter most to
people — like protecting abortion rights, improving wages, and preserving
our democracy.

My Republican opponent Larry Hogan hopes Marylanders won’t remember that
as governor, he vetoed legislation that would have expanded access to
abortion care throughout the state.

He’s banking on Marylanders forgetting that he vetoed a $15 minimum wage
and legislation to benefit unions and workers.

He’s hoping Marylanders won’t realize that electing him means handing
control of the Senate over to extremists like Ted Cruz and Lindsey Graham.

On the issues that matter most, Hogan’s record speaks for itself: He’s all
wrong for Maryland, and he’ll say and do whatever he thinks will win him
this seat.

Make the Case for a Democratic Senate Majority

Here’s the truth,
Peter: There simply isn’t any
way Democrats maintain our razor-thin Senate majority if Larry Hogan wins
this open seat.

Mitch McConnell handpicked Hogan for this race because he sees Maryland as
his best chance to flip a seat, retake the majority, and enact his
far-right, anti-choice agenda.

If the GOP retakes the Senate, they'll have the power to pass a national
abortion ban, roll back environmental protections, undermine our
elections, and so much more.

Hogan has proven that he cannot be trusted to protect our reproductive
rights or put Maryland families first. Defending the Senate is the only
way to protect our freedoms, uplift working families, and preserve our
democracy.

We’ve got a winning message that’s resonating with voters,
Peter, and I need your support
to make sure everyone hears it. [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/30946?t=1012&amount=25&akid=2436%2E52803%2EfZfy0M ]Can I count on you to chip in $25 to
give our grassroots team the resources we need to reach Marylanders across
the state?

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately.

Together,

Angela Alsobrooks

Will you give today to support these cornerstone principles? They are essential to the success of our nation--principles that can be bolstered immeasurably and immediately by strengthening our families. To show my appreciation for your gift of $100 or more, you will receive an advanced signed copy of my new book "The Perilous Fight: Overcoming Our Culture's War on the American Family".

Dr. Ben Carson

clean_body: It’s full of millionaires, formers business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me. = Hey there, The U.S. Senate is a country club. It’s full of millionaires, former business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me. If I defeat my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer in November, I will be the poorest member of the U.S. Senate. I don’t come from money, and I’m not rich. I’m a steamfitter and mechanic who works 50 and 60 hour weeks to give my kids a better life. I will be the only senator without a college degree. After my wife and I found out we were expecting a baby, I had to drop out and kill my dream of hanging a diploma on the wall because my family needed health insurance, diapers, and food on the table. I will be the only senator who is a blue-collar, card-carrying, union member. When Kellogg’s tried to cut our benefits and workers’ pay, we risked it all, went on strike, and walked the picket line for 11 weeks through the bitter cold Nebraska winter. We won and saved hundreds of good-paying jobs – before I was fired for being the union president who led the strike. There is no one who represents working-class people like me in the U.S. Senate. Which is why this is such big news: FIVE new polls show I am neck-and-neck with my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer. One even shows me LEADING by 2 points! I’ve taken on a big corporation before and won, and now I’m going to defeat one of the most corporate senators – my opponent Republican Deb Fischer – and win this Senate seat in November. But I need your help to do it. We’ve set a goal of raising another $50,000 before our next fundraising deadline at midnight tomorrow, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs like my opponent. body:
Sports leagues like the NCAA let men into women’s sports.
| Peter, I experienced the left’s radical gender ideology firsthand.
**When I was in college, I was forced to compete against a man at the NCAA Women’s Swimming Championships.** But instead of staying silent,**I spoke louder**. And I’m still speaking out, Peter. Men and women are different -- equal, but different. No matter how much the gender radicals demand otherwise. That’s why I’m fighting back, with the**Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute. ** Through the Riley Gaines Center, my team of Ambassadors and I spearhead a growing nationwide movement to defend women, common sense, and free speech. This isn’t just a women’s issue. _It’s a humanitarian issue_. It affects men and women, girls and boys. Because men don’t want to see women robbed of their opportunities or put in danger. And every person has the right to speak the truth. Will you help me speak louder and strengthen this movement? #
Friend of Life,

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? I'm asking 50 people to step forward today with a $50 gift to help us put our life-saving videos into classrooms nationwide**. **[https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=90a727cb562347b79d25b35023475a13&_e=qOyWhWsjYjVdTXZ8LhC15jbRjUd0rzOHTn7z0oob6VkdrL78efppQgkAfRfhN0fC54iZNI_flKRkkxwFXX_8sN-F0z-w0FsqasETqCSVmk3w_aeHreBV0UMkkyrOooYr1Las4P_3Twm7h21VYNZGiHtPb3J7Z8AcEVwWnORIeI76eHT8FdVoP6R2ZZLdKMoWwdSFkoO-pfKyyp7OAZEPJFiU2EWBkFaU71WblcWT6k_A3AgDMNxV0FSbS0KK2F410f2trsc8eQhwunjXr6vjq8q3Zskadr5FXAtw4QRJYEQ-xzw8CMevLYYeE2CJwwsL7Je2HUa-0xijTn_O5KX-4KKI0JFG4EioEakkiwfU_bA%3D)**

Planned Parenthood has continuously pushed egregious and pornographic materials in schools to young kids and teens -- and what do they "teach" these impressionable kids about sex? That disturbing practices are "normal" and "healthy."

In classic Planned Parenthood fashion, irrefutable definitions are warped, and morality is thrown out the window.

Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

**We need to protect our children against Planned Parenthood 's deception. This deadly organization should not be the educator of our children. **

Friend of Life, this is why we at Live Action have been creating - and are about to release! - wholesome sex-ed video series for schools across the country to use instead of Planned Parenthood's damaging materials.

We need to spread the truth about loving relationships between men and women and the beauty of procreation before the next generation of parents is convinced by Planned Parenthood's disturbing agenda that leads to abortion.

**But we can 't complete this critical initiative without your support. Your gift of $50 will help us complete the videos and get them into schools across the country. Use this secure link to make your gift and kick Planned Parenthood out of the classroom! [https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=90a727cb562347b79d25b35023475a13&_e=qOyWhWsjYjVdTXZ8LhC15jbRjUd0rzOHTn7z0oob6VkdrL78efppQgkAfRfhN0fC54iZNI_flKRkkxwFXX_8sN-F0z-w0FsqasETqCSVmk3w_aeHreBV0UMkkyrOooYr1Las4P_3Twm7h21VYNZGiHtPb3J7Z8AcEVwWnORIeI76eHT8FdVoP6R2ZZLdKMoWwdSFkoO-pfKyyp7OAZEPJGux0SqxH0f6YqkztTnXkkN528I2M01k3XhF4QAsZJv6uvWj2IOQ66BoF8TKqXOLWOIeR6fKUF-aCTEUNEc3ChEvyCzclBxdhuzFmxEboeclE0vR_-2wCZvbH6IvrnWwgSUqiLnXzEDS445eiA80qEc%3D)
**
Your partnership gives me so much hope. I can't wait to share the impact your activism will have in months to come. Our children - and grandchildren - depend on it.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

I’m facing my toughest re-election fight yet, and the stakes in this race could not be higher. We just got some alarming news — **a new poll from CNN shows me tied with my opponent, 46% to 46%.**

| | Hey friend, Juan here, Last week, I had the opportunity to debate my opponent and discuss the crucial issues facing Arizona’s 6th Congressional District and our nation. **I confronted critical topics from securing our borders to water security, contrasting sharply with Kirsten Engel's out-of-touch approach and voting record. ** It was clear from the debate that my opponent and I have vastly different views on the challenges our community faces— _**hardly surprising considering she doesn’t even live in the district.**_

**While I argued for nonpartisan, common-sense solutions, my opponent continued to divert the conversation to politics and lie about her out-of-touch record.** Here's what we covered and where I stand:
* **SECURING OUR BORDER:** I detailed our plans to enhance border security, essential for our district's safety and prosperity. To decrease border-related crimes and stop the flow of fentanyl over the border.
* _**MY RECORD**_ \- I voted in support of the most robust, border security legislation, H.R. 2. Legislation I introduced that would place a federal penalty for fleeing law enforcement, PASSED the House with all Republicans and 56 Democrats.
* _**HER RECORD**_ \- She voted against border security as a state legislator and says we have no immigration crisis ([watch here!](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=d2b19defd9&e=659fba240e)).

* **ECONOMIC GROWTH:** We discussed initiatives to foster economic growth and ensure that every Arizonan has the opportunity to succeed in a thriving job market and revive the American Dream for all Arizonans.
* _**MY RECORD**_ \- I voted in support of lower taxes, in support of gas stoves (no brainer!), and have used the last two years to work on more fiscally-responsible budgets. _We must get our federal spending under control! _
* _**HER RECORD**_ \- She wants to raise taxes, has endorsed the Biden-Harris spending ([chanted four more years in support](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=33ce6a2786&e=659fba240e)), and has recently been exposed for over-billing the federal government

* **WATER SECURITY:** I spoke on the importance of water security and highlighted the federal funding I've helped secure to improve our water infrastructure, supporting not only our residents but also vital industries such as mining and agriculture.
* _**MY RECORD**_ \- I have introduced legislation that supports water rights in our state for the Navajo Nation, Hopi Tribe, and the San Juan Southern Paiute Tribe ([more here](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=01332326f6&e=659fba240e)), I co-chair the Bipartisan Colorado River Caucus ([read about it here](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=5e8578bf52&e=659fba240e)), and have brought back more than $11 million in projects specifically for water in our congressional district.
* _**HER RECORD**_ \- She has played party politics while a state legislator.

* **SUPORTING OUR LAW ENFORCEMENT:** I emphasized my unwavering support for law enforcement and border patrol, ensuring they have the necessary resources to perform their duties effectively. My commitment has earned the endorsement of law enforcement groups across the district who trust that I have their backs.
* _**MY RECORD**_ \- Every law enforcement organization has ENDORSED our campaign for Congress ([see here](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=db8fe0ddcd&e=659fba240e)). I proudly stand with the men and women who protect our communities.
* _**HER RECORD**_ \- She supports defunding the police ([_watch in her words here_](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=f41a1efcf0&e=659fba240e)) and has returned police organization campaign contributions.

**Thank you for all of your support. Our campaign is so grateful for all of your hard work in sharing our message across the district. ** And I look forward to seeing you on the campaign trail! 🇺🇸 Juan Ciscomani

Legislation I introduced that would place a federal penalty for fleeing law enforcement, PASSED the House with all Republicans and 56 Democrats. HER RECORD \- She voted against border security as a state legislator and says we have no immigration crisis (). ECONOMIC GROWTH: We discussed initiatives to foster economic growth and ensure that every Arizonan has the opportunity to succeed in a thriving job market and revive the American Dream for all Arizonans. MY RECORD \- I voted in support of lower taxes, in support of gas stoves (no brainer!), and have used the last two years to work on more fiscally-responsible budgets. We must get our federal spending under control! HER RECORD \- She wants to raise taxes, has endorsed the Biden-Harris spending (), and has recently been exposed for over-billing the federal government WATER SECURITY: I spoke on the importance of water security and highlighted the federal funding I've helped secure to improve our water infrastructure, supporting not only our residents but also vital industries such as mining and agriculture. MY RECORD \- I have introduced legislation that supports water rights in our state for the Navajo Nation, Hopi Tribe, and the San Juan Southern Paiute Tribe (), I co-chair the Bipartisan Colorado River Caucus (), and have brought back more than $11 million in projects specifically for water in our congressional district. HER RECORD \- She has played party politics while a state legislator. SUPORTING OUR LAW ENFORCEMENT: I emphasized my unwavering support for law enforcement and border patrol, ensuring they have the necessary resources to perform their duties effectively. My commitment has earned the endorsement of law enforcement groups across the district who trust that I have their backs. MY RECORD \- Every law enforcement organization has ENDORSED our campaign for Congress (). I proudly stand with the men and women who protect our communities. HER RECORD \- She supports defunding the police () and has returned police organization campaign contributions. Thank you for all of your support. Our campaign is so grateful for all of your hard work in sharing our message across the district. And I look forward to seeing you on the campaign trail! 🇺🇸 Juan Ciscomani | | | VOLUNTEER: Join Team Ciscomani today at an upcoming event, knock doors, make phone calls and talk to voters! body:

| |
---
| Good morning Friend,

**Young Americans need to appreciate what makes America so exceptional. **

MCPP is delighted to offer a two part course for high school students that aims to do precisely that!

**Our Mississippi Leadership Academy program for 2024 is specifically designed for high school students. **Do you have children or grandchildren that would benefit by taking part?

The two part program takes place in Jackson on Saturday October 12th and Saturday November 9th.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=6454903eec&e=5703353baa)

_Click above to learn more information and apply!_
| Leading academics and state leaders will be speaking and include Attorney General Lynn Fitch, State Auditor Shad White, Starla Brown from Americans for Prosperity, Forest Thigpen from Empower, and Douglas Carswell from MCPP.

The Mississippi Leadership Academy offers an incredible opportunity to engage with thought leaders and develop leadership skills.

There is no charge for taking part, and those that graduate will be given a Certificate and Letter of Recommendation. In previous years, several of our graduates from the program have interned with state leaders.
---
|
---
We are committed to empowering future leaders who are ready to step up, engage, and lead with integrity. If you or someone you know is interested in shaping the future of our state, we encourage you to apply or share this information with others.

Together, we can strengthen the future of Mississippi through principled leadership!

Warmest wishes,

Anika Page

| | | | A lot of folks probably don’t know this, folks, but Kamala Harris and I actually go way back. Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide opportunities for all families. She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our relationship has helped shape how I view public service. I often refer to her as “ _my quintessential big sister_ ,” because she has always shown up for me when I needed her. In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her. I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: _More important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the last._ And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever. Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent.
